source.text: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהוָה֙ עִם־יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֠י אֵין־אֱמֶ֧ת וְֽאֵין־חֶ֛סֶד וְאֵֽין־דַּ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear [the] word of Yahweh, sons of Israel, for [a] case [belongs] to Yahweh with [the] inhabitants of the land, for there is no faithfulness and no loyal love and no knowledge of God in the land.

en.L: Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a case against the inhabitants of the land, \q for there is no faithfulness, and no loyal love, and no knowledge of God in the land.
en.B: Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{gender:people|sons}} of Israel, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a charge to bring against those who live in the land: \q there is no faithfulness, no loyal love, and no knowledge of God in the land.
en.R: People of Israel, listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is bringing charges against the people who live in the land, \q because there is no faithfulness, no faithful love, and no knowing God in the land.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hijos de Israel, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene un pleito con los habitantes de la tierra, \q porque no hay fidelidad, ni amor leal, ni conocimiento de Dios en la tierra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, israelitas, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene una acusación contra los que viven en la tierra: \q no hay fidelidad, ni amor fiel, ni conocimiento de Dios en la tierra.
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} presenta cargos contra la gente que vive en la tierra, \q porque en la tierra no hay fidelidad, ni amor fiel, ni nadie que conozca a Dios.

fr.L: Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a un procès avec les habitants du pays, \q car il n’y a ni fidélité, ni amour loyal, ni connaissance de Dieu dans le pays.
fr.B: Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a une accusation à porter contre les habitants du pays : \q il n’y a ni fidélité, ni amour fidèle, ni connaissance de Dieu dans le pays.
fr.R: {{gender:Israélites|Fils d’Israël}}, écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} porte plainte contre les gens qui habitent le pays, \q parce que dans le pays, il n’y a ni fidélité ni amour fidèle, et personne ne connaît Dieu.

ko.L: 이스라엘 자손아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅의 주민들과 다투실 일이 있다. \q 이 땅에는 신실함도 없고, 한결같은 사랑도 없고, 하나님을 아는 지식도 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅에 사는 사람들을 고소하신다. \q 이 땅에는 신실함도 없고, 한결같은 사랑도 없고, 하나님을 아는 지식도 없다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅에 사는 사람들을 재판에 걸고 계신다. \q 이 땅에는 신실함도 없고, 변함없는 사랑도 없고, 하나님을 아는 사람도 없기 때문이다.

vi.L: Hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có một vụ kiện với dân cư trong xứ, \q vì trong xứ không có sự trung tín, không có tình yêu thương thành tín, và không có sự hiểu biết Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có lời buộc tội những người sống trong xứ: \q trong xứ không có sự trung tín, không có tình yêu thương thành tín, cũng không có sự hiểu biết Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang buộc tội những người sống trong xứ, \q vì trong xứ không có lòng trung tín, không có tình thương không hề thay đổi, cũng không ai biết Đức Chúa Trời.

sw.L: Sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi wana wa Israeli, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana mashtaka dhidi ya wakaao katika nchi, \q kwa maana hakuna uaminifu, wala upendo usiokoma, wala kumjua Mungu katika nchi.
sw.B: Sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu wa Israeli, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana mashtaka dhidi ya wale wanaoishi katika nchi: \q hakuna uaminifu, hakuna upendo usiokoma, wala kumjua Mungu katika nchi.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawashtaki watu wanaoishi katika nchi, \q kwa sababu hakuna uaminifu, hakuna upendo usiokoma, wala hakuna anayemjua Mungu katika nchi.

pt.L: Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, filhos de Israel, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma causa contra os habitantes da terra, \q porque não há fidelidade, e não há amor leal, e não há conhecimento de Deus na terra.
pt.B: Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, israelitas, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma acusação a apresentar contra os que vivem na terra: \q não há fidelidade, não há amor leal, não há conhecimento de Deus na terra.
pt.R: Povo de Israel, escute o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está levando ao tribunal as pessoas que vivem na terra, \q porque na terra não há fidelidade, nem amor fiel, nem quem conheça a Deus.

am.L: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ስሙ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በምድሪቱ ከሚኖሩት ጋር ክርክር አለውና፤ \q በምድሪቱ ታማኝነት፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርም፣ እግዚአብሔርንም ማወቅ የለምና።
am.B: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ስሙ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በምድሪቱ በሚኖሩት ላይ የሚያቀርበው ክስ አለውና፤ \q በምድሪቱ ታማኝነት የለም፤ ጽኑ ፍቅር የለም፤ እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅም የለም።
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚለውን ስሙ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በምድሪቱ በሚኖሩት ሰዎች ላይ ክስ ያቀርባል፤ \q በምድሪቱ ታማኝነት፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርና እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ የለምና።

hi.L: हे {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}}, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो, \q क्योंकि देश के निवासियों के साथ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का मुक़दमा है, \q क्योंकि देश में न सच्चाई है, न अटल प्रेम, और न परमेश्वर का ज्ञान।
hi.B: हे {{gender:इस्राएल के लोगो|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}}, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो, \q क्योंकि देश में रहनेवालों के विरुद्ध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को मुक़दमा चलाना है: \q देश में न विश्वासयोग्यता है, न अटल प्रेम, और न परमेश्वर का ज्ञान।
hi.R: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, सुनो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} क्या कहते हैं। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} देश में रहनेवाले लोगों पर दोष लगा रहे हैं, \q क्योंकि देश में न विश्वासयोग्यता है, न सच्चा प्रेम, और न कोई परमेश्वर को जानता है।

ru.L: Слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}, \q потому что у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} тяжба с жителями земли, \q потому что нет ни верности, ни неизменной любви, ни знания Бога на земле.
ru.B: Слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, израильтяне, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} предъявляет обвинение жителям этой земли: \q нет на земле ни верности, ни преданной любви, ни знания Бога.
ru.R: Народ Израиля, послушайте, что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обвиняет людей, которые живут в этой стране, \q потому что в стране нет верности, нет преданной любви, никто не знает Бога.

ja.L: イスラエルの子らよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞け。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}には、この地に住む者たちに対する訴えがあるからだ。 \q この地には、まことも、誠実も、神を知る知識もないからだ。
ja.B: イスラエルの人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞きなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この地に住む者たちを訴えておられる。 \q この地には、まことも誠実もなく、神を知ることもない。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われることを聞きなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この地に住む人々を訴えておられる。 \q この地には、真実も誠実な愛もなく、神を知る人もいないからだ。

decisions.choice: the LORD has a case: a charge brought in a court of law
decisions.reason: The word (riv) is the word for a lawsuit or a dispute taken to court. The LORD speaks as the one bringing the charge, and the people of the land are the accused; the charges follow in verses 1-2. Chapters 4-14 open with this summons, and the same picture returns in 12:3 and in Micah 6:1-2. Chapter 2:4 uses the same verb for the children's case against their mother.

decisions.choice: knowledge of God: knowing God personally and living by what he has made known, not only knowing facts about him
alternatives: knowledge about God: correct information or teaching about him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb "know" is used for close personal relationship, even for the bond of husband and wife (Genesis 4:1), and for loyal acknowledgment of a lord. In Hosea "knowledge of God" stands beside faithfulness and loyal love (here) and beside loyal love against sacrifice (6:6), so it means a life that acknowledges the LORD: hearing his instruction (4:6), keeping faith with him, and treating others as he requires (4:2). The promise of 2:22 is "you will know the LORD"; the charge here and in 4:6 and 5:4 is that the people do not. This is the main note on the phrase in Hosea; 4:6, 5:4 and 6:6 refer back to it.

decisions.choice: faithfulness (emet) and loyal love (hesed): the two marks of keeping a covenant
decisions.reason: Emet is firmness and reliability: being true to one's word. Hesed is the loyal love owed within a covenant, here both toward God and toward one's neighbor. The two words are often paired (Genesis 24:27; Exodus 34:6; Psalm 85:11), and Hosea sets knowledge of God beside them. All three are missing "in the land", among the people as a whole.

decisions.choice: the inhabitants of the land: the people of the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: The summons is to "the sons of Israel", and the land is Israel's land. The charge is against the whole population, not only its leaders; the priests are singled out from verse 4.

decisions.choice: children of Israel (Literal); people of Israel (Balanced, Readable), with "sons of Israel" as the setting's alternative
decisions.reason: "Sons of Israel" is the ordinary name for the people of Israel, men and women alike, so the gender setting gives the inclusive form by default.

decisions.choice: loyal love (Literal, Balanced), faithful love (Readable); knowledge of God (Literal, Balanced), knowing God (Readable)
decisions.reason: These follow the settled wording for hesed and for da'at elohim in Hosea. Readable's "knowing God" shows that a relationship is meant, not information (m2).

decisions.choice: "conocimiento de Dios" (L, B); "conocer a Dios" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for Hosea; the same at 4:6 and 6:6.

decisions.choice: "[[Oigan|Oíd]] la palabra del SEÑOR" (L); "[[Escuchen|Escuchad]] la palabra del SEÑOR" (B); "[[escuchen|escuchad]] lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R); "hijos de Israel" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The summons as the Spanish prophets have it; Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already include women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "Écoutez la parole du SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "écoutez le message du SEIGNEUR" (R); "la connaissance de Dieu" (L, B), "connaître Dieu" (R, "personne ne connaît Dieu")
decisions.reason: The summons and the phrase as the term sheet sets them for the Twelve; Readable turns the noun into a verb, as the English Readable "knowing God" does.

decisions.choice: "신실함"; "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R); "하나님을 아는 지식" (L, B), "하나님을 아는 사람도 없다" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for *emet*, *hesed* and *da'at 'elohim*; R makes the knowledge a matter of knowing God, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L), "이스라엘 백성" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" and "백성" already include men and women, so the English gender span has nothing to change here; the span is kept only where Korean has two wordings ("{{gender:자녀|아들}}들").

decisions.choice: "sự trung tín" (emet); "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R) (hesed); "sự hiểu biết Đức Chúa Trời" (L, B), "biết Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Hesed and "knowledge of God" take the terms note's wording, used through Hosea. Emet is "sự trung tín" so that it stays distinct from the "thành tín" inside the hesed phrase.

decisions.choice: "Hãy nghe lời của CHÚA" (L); "hãy nghe lời CHÚA" (B); "hãy nghe điều CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah and Jeremiah note's wording for "Hear the word of the LORD".

decisions.choice: "kumjua Mungu" (knowledge of God)
decisions.reason: At every level, as the term sheet settles: the Hebrew is knowing God personally (m2), and "maarifa ya Mungu" would read as God's own knowledge. Readable turns it into a clause, "hakuna anayemjua Mungu".

decisions.choice: "Sikieni neno la BWANA" (L); "Sikilizeni neno la BWANA" (B); "sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: The summons as Isaiah and 2 Kings 20:16 word it (term sheet).

decisions.choice: fidelidade; amor leal (L, B), amor fiel (R); o conhecimento de Deus (L, B), conhecer a Deus (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: emet is "fidelidade", being true to one's word (m3). Hesed keeps the words set at 2:21, "amor leal" (L, B) and "amor fiel" (R), here and where it is the loyalty owed between people and toward God (6:4, 6), because the English levels keep "loyal love" and "faithful love" there too; where an English level says "loyalty" or "faithfulness" instead, Portuguese says "lealdade" or "fidelidade" with it. Da'at elohim is "o conhecimento de Deus" at Literal and Balanced and "conhecer a Deus" at Readable, the verb showing that a relationship is meant (m2), as the English does (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: filhos de Israel (L), israelitas (B), Povo de Israel (R); causa (L), acusação (B), levando ao tribunal (R)
decisions.reason: "Filhos" needs no gender setting (2:1). The lawsuit word riv (m1) keeps the court at each level as at 2:4: "causa" at Literal, "acusação" at Balanced and "levar ao tribunal" at Readable, as Jeremiah 2:9 sets it. The summons is plural, so "Ouçam" (L, B); Readable addresses the people as one, "escute", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: "ታማኝነት" (ʾemet), "ጽኑ ፍቅር" (ḥesed) and "እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ" ("knowledge of God")
decisions.reason: The three covenant words Hosea uses through the book get one Amharic form each. "Knowledge of God" is worded with the verb, "knowing God", because the meaning decision says it is personal acknowledgment, not facts about him; Elohim here is "እግዚአብሔር", the one God.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (L) and "የእስራኤል ሕዝብ" (B, R), nor on "ልጆችህ" (4:6)
decisions.reason: Both Amharic words already include men and women, so the English span has nothing to change (style guide 7b).

decisions.choice: अटल प्रेम (L, B), सच्चा प्रेम (R) for human hesed; परमेश्वर का ज्ञान (L, B), परमेश्वर को जानना (R) for da'at elohim
alternatives: कृपा (B, R), as the history note has for hesed between people
decisions.reason: Hosea's English settles one wording for hesed through the book, "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced whoever shows it, because 4:1, 6:4, 6:6, 10:12 and 12:7 measure Israel's love against the LORD's (2:21). Hindi follows: अटल प्रेम at Literal and Balanced; at Readable the LORD's hesed stays अटल प्रेम and Israel's is सच्चा प्रेम ("faithful love"). Knowledge of God is परमेश्वर का ज्ञान, as Isaiah 11:9 has "the knowledge of the LORD"; Readable says that no one knows God, since a personal knowing is meant (m2). Faithfulness (emet) is सच्चाई (L), विश्वासयोग्यता (B, R), as Psalms.

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल के लोगो|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}} (B); इस्राएल के लोगो (R), no span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced has a gender span on "sons of Israel" here, in an address. Hindi keeps it at Balanced (लोगो, "people", with पुत्रो as the alternative); Readable says इस्राएल के लोगो without a span, since लोग already includes everyone.

decisions.choice: верность; неизменная любовь (L), преданная любовь (B, R); знание Бога (L, B), знать Бога (R)
decisions.reason: The Hosea wording for the three covenant marks. Faithfulness (emet) is "верность". Hesed here is the people's loyal love to God and to one another: Literal keeps "неизменная любовь", the Pentateuch note's Literal word; Balanced and Readable say "преданная любовь", since "милость" (the note's word for a favour between people) would not carry covenant loyalty, and "верная любовь" would echo "верность" in the same line. Da'at Elohim is "знание Бога" at Literal and Balanced and "знать Бога" at Readable (m2). The same wording returns in 6:4, 6:6, 10:12 and 12:7.

decisions.choice: дети / сыны Израиля (L, gender setting); израильтяне (B); народ Израиля (R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note settles: the gender setting at Literal, and "израильтяне" or "народ Израиля" with no span at Balanced and Readable, where the English Balanced has a span; the people as a whole are meant.

decisions.choice: da'at Elohim "knowledge of God": "神を知る知識" (L), "神を知ること" (B), "神を知る人もいない" (R, as the English Readable "no knowing God"), as Proverbs 2:5; the knowing of God, not facts about him (m2), so the verb "知る" is kept at every level and the same verb runs through the book (2:22, 4:6, 5:4, 6:3, 6:6, 13:4). 'emet "まこと" (L, B), "真実" (R), and hesed between the people and God "誠実" (L, B), "誠実な愛" (R, for the English Readable "faithful love"), as "誠実とまこと" in the Psalms.
decisions.reason: The book's central charge; keeping one verb lets the reader follow it from 2:22 to 6:6.

decisions.choice: riv "case" (m1): "訴え" (L), "訴えておられる" (B, R), with the light respect form for the LORD in the prophet's voice. shim'u devar YHWH "主の言葉を聞け" (L), "聞きなさい" (B, R), as Isaiah 1:10. The gender span on "children / sons" needs no Japanese span ("イスラエルの子ら", "人々").
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions.

source.text: אָלֹ֣ה וְכַחֵ֔שׁ וְרָצֹ֥חַ וְגָנֹ֖ב וְנָאֹ֑ף פָּרָ֕צוּ וְדָמִ֥ים בְּדָמִ֖ים נָגָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursing and deceiving and murdering and stealing and committing adultery! They break out, and bloodshed touches bloodshed.

en.L: Swearing and lying and murdering and stealing and committing adultery! \q They break out, and bloodshed touches bloodshed.
en.B: Cursing, lying, murder, stealing and adultery! \q They break through every limit, and one killing follows another.
en.R: People curse and lie, kill, steal and commit adultery. \q They break every limit, and one murder comes right after another.

es.L: ¡Maldecir, mentir, matar, robar y cometer adulterio! \q Irrumpen, y sangre derramada toca sangre derramada.
es.B: ¡Maldición, mentira, asesinato, robo y adulterio! \q Rompen todo límite, y un crimen sigue a otro.
es.R: La gente maldice y miente, mata, roba y comete adulterio. \q Rompen todos los límites, y un asesinato viene justo detrás de otro.

fr.L: Jurer et mentir, et tuer, et voler, et commettre l’adultère ! \q Ils font irruption, et le sang touche le sang.
fr.B: Malédiction, mensonge, meurtre, vol et adultère ! \q Ils franchissent toute limite, et un meurtre suit l’autre.
fr.R: Les gens maudissent et mentent, ils tuent, ils volent et ils commettent l’adultère. \q Ils franchissent toutes les limites, et les meurtres se suivent sans arrêt.

ko.L: 저주하고 속이고 살인하고 도둑질하고 간음한다! \q 그들이 [모든 한계를] 터뜨리니, 피가 피에 닿는다.
ko.B: 저주와 거짓말과 살인과 도둑질과 간음뿐이다! \q 그들은 모든 한계를 넘어서고, 살인에 살인이 꼬리를 문다.
ko.R: 사람들은 저주하고 거짓말하고, 죽이고 훔치고 간음한다. \q 그들은 지켜야 할 선을 다 넘었고, 살인이 끊이지 않는다.

vi.L: Thề rủa, nói dối, giết người, trộm cắp và ngoại tình! \q Chúng phá vỡ [mọi giới hạn], và máu đổ chạm đến máu đổ.
vi.B: Nguyền rủa, dối trá, giết người, trộm cắp và ngoại tình! \q Chúng vượt qua mọi giới hạn, và hết vụ đổ máu này đến vụ đổ máu khác.
vi.R: Người ta nguyền rủa và nói dối, giết người, trộm cắp và ngoại tình. \q Chúng phá bỏ mọi giới hạn, và hết vụ giết người này lại đến vụ giết người khác.

sw.L: Kulaani na kudanganya na kuua na kuiba na kuzini! \q Wanavunja mipaka, na damu inagusa damu.
sw.B: Laana, uongo, mauaji, wizi na uzinzi! \q Wamevunja kila mpaka, na mauaji yanafuata mauaji.
sw.R: Watu wanalaani na kudanganya, wanaua, wanaiba na kuzini. \q Wamevunja kila mpaka, na mtu mmoja anauawa baada ya mwingine.

pt.L: Jurar e mentir e matar e roubar e adulterar! \q Eles irrompem, e sangue toca sangue.
pt.B: Maldição, mentira, assassinato, roubo e adultério! \q Eles rompem todos os limites, e um assassinato segue outro.
pt.R: As pessoas amaldiçoam e mentem, matam, roubam e cometem adultério. \q Rompem todos os limites, e um assassinato vem logo depois do outro.

am.L: መማል፣ መዋሸት፣ መግደል፣ መስረቅ፣ ማመንዘርም! \q ሰብረው ይወጣሉ፤ ደምም ደምን ይነካል።
am.B: መራገም፣ መዋሸት፣ መግደል፣ መስረቅና ማመንዘር! \q ገደብን ሁሉ ጥሰዋል፤ ግድያም ግድያን ይከተላል።
am.R: ሰዎች ይራገማሉ፤ ይዋሻሉ፤ ይገድላሉ፤ ይሰርቃሉ፤ ያመነዝራሉም። \q ገደብን ሁሉ ይጥሳሉ፤ አንዱ ግድያ ሌላውን ግድያ ወዲያው ይከተላል።

hi.L: शाप देना और झूठ बोलना और हत्या करना और चोरी करना और व्यभिचार करना! \q वे सीमा तोड़ देते हैं, और ख़ून पर ख़ून होता है।
hi.B: शाप, झूठ, हत्या, चोरी और व्यभिचार! \q वे हर सीमा तोड़ देते हैं, और एक हत्या के बाद दूसरी हत्या होती है।
hi.R: लोग शाप देते हैं और झूठ बोलते हैं, हत्या करते हैं, चोरी करते हैं और व्यभिचार करते हैं। \q वे हर सीमा तोड़ देते हैं, और एक के बाद एक ख़ून होता है।

ru.L: Проклинать, и лгать, и убивать, и красть, и прелюбодействовать! \q Они преступают [всё], и кровь касается крови.
ru.B: Проклятия, ложь, убийство, воровство и прелюбодеяние! \q Они преступают всякую меру, и одно убийство следует за другим.
ru.R: Люди проклинают и лгут, убивают, крадут и нарушают супружескую верность. \q Они переходят все границы, и одно убийство следует сразу за другим.

ja.L: 呪うこと、欺くこと、殺すこと、盗むこと、姦淫すること！ \q 彼らは[すべての垣を]破り、血は血に触れる。
ja.B: 呪い、偽り、人殺し、盗み、姦淫！ \q 彼らはあらゆる限度を越え、殺人に殺人が続く。
ja.R: 人々は呪い、うそをつき、人を殺し、盗み、姦淫をする。 \q 彼らはあらゆる限度を越え、人殺しが次から次へと起こる。

decisions.choice: murder, stealing, adultery and false speech: the Ten Commandments broken
decisions.reason: The list follows the second half of the Ten Commandments: "You shall not murder; you shall not commit adultery; you shall not steal; you shall not bear false witness" (Exodus 20:13-16; Deuteronomy 5:17-20). "Swearing" (or cursing) may stand for misuse of the LORD's name (Exodus 20:7). Hosea's list shows what the lack of knowledge of God in verse 1 looks like in daily life.

decisions.choice: swearing: uttering curses or oaths, here probably false oaths
alternatives: cursing: calling down harm on others
decisions.reason: The verb is used both for laying a curse and for taking an oath, which called down a curse on the one who swore falsely (Numbers 5:21; Judges 17:2). Paired with "lying", it probably means swearing falsely.

decisions.choice: a list of bare verbs: a short, sharp indictment
decisions.reason: The five crimes are given as infinitives, with no subject and no verb of being, like a charge sheet read out in court.

decisions.choice: a list of verbs (Literal); a list of nouns (Balanced); a sentence (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the bare list of verbs; Balanced turns it into nouns, which English can set out as a list; Readable supplies a subject and makes it a sentence (m3).

decisions.choice: they break out, and bloodshed touches bloodshed: violence breaks every restraint, and one killing follows on another
decisions.reason: "Break out" is used for bursting through a wall or a boundary (2 Samuel 5:20); here it means breaking every limit of the law. "Bloods" in Hebrew means bloodshed or blood guilt. One act of bloodshed "touches" the next: killings come so fast that they meet. Hosea 6:8-9 and 7:7 speak of such killings, and 2 Kings 15 tells how four kings of Israel were murdered within about twenty years.

decisions.choice: break through every limit ... one killing follows another (Balanced); break every limit ... one murder comes right after another (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew pictures. Balanced and Readable say what they mean (m4).

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֣ן׀תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֻמְלַל֙ כָּל־יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ בְּחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם יֵאָסֵֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore mourns the land, and languishes every [one] dwelling in it, with [the] animals of the field and with [the] birds of the heavens; and also [the] fish of the sea are taken away.

en.L: Therefore the land mourns, and everyone who dwells in it languishes, together with the beasts of the field and with the birds of the heavens; \q and even the fish of the sea are taken away.
en.B: So the land mourns, and all who live in it waste away, along with the wild animals and the birds of the sky; \q even the fish of the sea are swept away.
en.R: So the land is in mourning, and everyone who lives in it is wasting away, with the wild animals and the birds, \q and even the fish in the sea are disappearing.

es.L: Por eso la tierra está de luto, y desfallece todo el que habita en ella, junto con las bestias del campo y con las aves de los cielos; \q y aun los peces del mar desaparecen.
es.B: Por eso la tierra está de luto, y todos los que viven en ella se consumen, junto con los animales salvajes y las aves del cielo; \q hasta los peces del mar son arrebatados.
es.R: Por eso la tierra está de luto, y todos los que viven en ella se van consumiendo, junto con los animales salvajes y las aves, \q y hasta los peces del mar están desapareciendo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi le pays est en deuil, et tous ceux qui y habitent dépérissent, avec les bêtes des champs et avec les oiseaux du ciel ; \q et même les poissons de la mer sont enlevés.
fr.B: Alors le pays est en deuil, et tous ses habitants dépérissent, avec les bêtes sauvages et les oiseaux du ciel ; \q même les poissons de la mer sont emportés.
fr.R: Alors le pays est en deuil, et tous ceux qui y vivent dépérissent, avec les animaux sauvages et les oiseaux, \q et même les poissons de la mer disparaissent.

ko.L: 그러므로 이 땅이 슬퍼하고, 그 안에 사는 모든 사람이 들짐승과 하늘의 새와 함께 시들어 간다. \q 바다의 물고기들까지 사라져 간다.
ko.B: 그래서 땅은 통곡하고, 그 안에 사는 모든 사람은 들짐승과 공중의 새와 함께 쇠약해진다. \q 바다의 물고기들마저 사라진다.
ko.R: 그래서 땅은 슬픔에 잠기고, 그 안에 사는 사람들은 모두 들짐승과 새들과 함께 시들어 간다. \q 바다의 물고기들까지 사라지고 있다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, đất than khóc, và mọi kẻ ở trong đó đều mòn mỏi, cùng với thú đồng và chim trời; \q ngay cả cá biển cũng bị cất đi.
vi.B: Vì thế, đất than khóc, và mọi người sống trong đó đều héo hon, cùng với thú hoang và chim trời; \q ngay cả cá biển cũng bị quét sạch.
vi.R: Vì thế, đất đai đang than khóc, và mọi người sống trong đó đều đang mòn mỏi, cùng với thú hoang và chim chóc, \q ngay cả cá dưới biển cũng đang biến mất.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nchi inaomboleza, na kila akaaye ndani yake anadhoofika, pamoja na wanyama wa mwituni na ndege wa angani; \q hata samaki wa baharini wanaondolewa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nchi inaomboleza, na wote wanaoishi ndani yake wanadhoofika, pamoja na wanyama wa porini na ndege wa angani; \q hata samaki wa baharini wanafagiliwa mbali.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nchi iko katika maombolezo, na kila mtu anayeishi ndani yake anadhoofika, pamoja na wanyama wa porini na ndege, \q na hata samaki baharini wanatoweka.

pt.L: Por isso a terra pranteia, e definha todo aquele que nela habita, junto com os animais do campo e com as aves dos céus; \q e até os peixes do mar são arrebatados.
pt.B: Por isso a terra está de luto, e todos os que nela vivem definham, junto com os animais selvagens e as aves do céu; \q até os peixes do mar são levados embora.
pt.R: Por isso a terra está de luto, e todos os que vivem nela estão definhando, junto com os animais selvagens e as aves, \q e até os peixes do mar estão desaparecendo.

am.L: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ ታለቅሳለች፤ በእርሷም የሚኖር ሁሉ ከሜዳ አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ይዝላል፤ \q የባሕርም ዓሦች እንኳ ይወሰዳሉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ ታለቅሳለች፤ በእርሷም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ከዱር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ይመነምናሉ፤ \q የባሕር ዓሦች እንኳ ይጠፋሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ በሐዘን ላይ ናት፤ በእርሷ የሚኖር ሁሉ ከዱር አራዊትና ከወፎች ጋር እየመነመነ ነው፤ \q በባሕር ያሉ ዓሦች እንኳ እየጠፉ ናቸው።

hi.L: इस कारण देश विलाप करता है, और उसमें रहनेवाला हर एक मुरझा जाता है, मैदान के पशुओं और आकाश के पक्षियों समेत; \q और समुद्र की मछलियाँ भी उठा ली जाती हैं।
hi.B: इसलिए देश विलाप करता है, और उसमें रहनेवाले सब जंगली पशुओं और आकाश के पक्षियों समेत मुरझा जाते हैं; \q समुद्र की मछलियाँ भी मिटती जाती हैं।
hi.R: इसलिए देश शोक मना रहा है, और उसमें रहनेवाले सब लोग, जंगली जानवरों और पक्षियों के साथ, सूखते जा रहे हैं, \q और समुद्र की मछलियाँ भी ग़ायब होती जा रही हैं।

ru.L: Поэтому скорбит земля, и изнемогает всякий живущий на ней, вместе с полевыми зверями и с птицами небесными; \q и даже рыбы морские исчезают.
ru.B: Поэтому земля скорбит, и все, кто живёт на ней, чахнут, вместе с дикими зверями и птицами небесными; \q даже рыба в море гибнет.
ru.R: Поэтому земля в трауре, и все, кто живёт на ней, слабеют и гибнут, вместе с дикими зверями и птицами, \q и даже рыба в море исчезает.

ja.L: それゆえ、地は喪に服し、そこに住む者はみな、野の獣と共に、空の鳥と共に衰え果てる。 \q 海の魚さえも取り去られる。
ja.B: それゆえ、地は嘆き悲しみ、そこに住む者はみな、野の獣や空の鳥と共に衰え果てる。 \q 海の魚さえも消え去る。
ja.R: だから、この地は悲しみに沈み、そこに住む人はみな、野の獣や鳥と共に弱り果てていく。 \q 海の魚さえ、いなくなっていく。

decisions.choice: mourns: the land grieves, pictured as a person in mourning
alternatives: dries up: the land is parched in drought
decisions.reason: Two Hebrew verbs are spelled alike: one means "mourn", the other "dry up". The prophets use the picture of a mourning land when drought or judgment strips it (Isaiah 24:4; Jeremiah 12:4; Joel 1:10), and the parallel verb "languish" is used for withering plants. Either way the land suffers because of its people's sin. Readers who take the drying-up sense see a drought here.

decisions.choice: beasts of the field, birds of the heavens, fish of the sea: creation undone
decisions.reason: The three groups are the living creatures of Genesis 1:20-28, named in reverse order to the creation account (fish, birds, land animals), and they return in God's promised covenant with the animals in Hosea 2:20. Here they suffer with the land. Zephaniah 1:3 uses the same list for judgment on the whole earth.

decisions.choice: therefore: because of the crimes of verses 1-2
decisions.reason: The people's sin brings harm on the land itself and on all that lives in it, as Leviticus 18:25-28 and Jeremiah 12:4 also say.

decisions.choice: are taken away: are swept away, perish
decisions.reason: The verb means "gathered" or "taken away"; used of living things it means they are removed by death (Zephaniah 1:2-3, where the same picture of creation's undoing uses it).

decisions.choice: wild animals ... birds of the sky (Balanced); wild animals ... birds (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Beasts of the field" means animals that live in the open country, as opposed to livestock; Balanced and Readable say "wild animals".

source.text: אַ֥ךְ אִ֛ישׁ אַל־יָרֵ֖ב וְאַל־יוֹכַ֣ח אִ֑ישׁ וְעַמְּךָ֖ כִּמְרִיבֵ֥י כֹהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Yet [let] anyone not bring a case, and [let] not reprove anyone; and your people [are] like contenders [with a] priest.

en.L: Yet let no one bring a case, and let no one reprove another, \q for your people [are] like those who contend with a priest.
en.B: Yet let no one bring a charge, and let no one accuse another, \q for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
en.R: But do not let anyone bring charges or blame someone else. \q Your people are like those who argue against a priest.

es.L: Pero que nadie contienda, y que nadie reprenda, \q porque tu pueblo [es] como los que contienden con el sacerdote.
es.B: Pero que nadie presente cargos, ni nadie acuse a otro, \q porque tu pueblo es como los que contienden con el sacerdote.
es.R: Pero que nadie acuse ni culpe a otro. \q Tu pueblo es como los que discuten contra un sacerdote.

fr.L: Cependant, que personne ne plaide, et que personne ne reprenne [un autre], \q car ton peuple [est] comme ceux qui contestent avec un prêtre.
fr.B: Pourtant, que personne n’accuse, que personne ne fasse de reproche à un autre, \q car ton peuple est comme ceux qui contestent avec un prêtre.
fr.R: Mais que personne n’accuse ni ne blâme quelqu’un d’autre. \q Ton peuple est comme ceux qui se disputent avec un prêtre.

ko.L: 그러나 아무도 다투지 말고, 아무도 [남을] 꾸짖지 마라. \q 네 백성은 제사장과 다투는 자들과 같기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 아무도 고소하지 말고, 아무도 남을 탓하지 마라. \q 네 백성은 제사장에게 대드는 자들과 같다.
ko.R: 그러나 아무도 남을 고발하거나 탓하지 마라. \q 네 백성은 제사장에게 대드는 사람들과 같다.

vi.L: Dù vậy, chớ ai kiện cáo, và chớ ai khiển trách [người khác], \q vì dân ngươi [giống] như những kẻ tranh cãi với thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Dù vậy, đừng ai buộc tội, cũng đừng ai trách móc người khác, \q vì dân ngươi giống như những kẻ tranh cãi với thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Nhưng đừng để ai buộc tội hay đổ lỗi cho người khác. \q Dân ngươi giống như những kẻ cãi lại thầy tế lễ.

sw.L: Lakini mtu yeyote asilete mashtaka, wala mtu asimkemee mwingine, \q kwa maana watu wako [ni] kama wale wanaoshindana na kuhani.
sw.B: Lakini mtu yeyote asilete mashtaka, wala mtu asimlaumu mwingine, \q kwa maana watu wako ni kama wale wanaoshindana na kuhani.
sw.R: Lakini mtu yeyote asilete mashtaka wala kumlaumu mwingine. \q Watu wako ni kama wale wanaobishana na kuhani.

pt.L: Contudo, que ninguém conteste, e que ninguém repreenda, \q pois o teu povo [é] como os que contendem com um sacerdote.
pt.B: Mas que ninguém apresente acusação, que ninguém repreenda o outro, \q pois o teu povo é como os que contendem com um sacerdote.
pt.R: Mas que ninguém faça acusações nem ponha a culpa nos outros. \q O teu povo é como gente que discute com um sacerdote.

am.L: ነገር ግን ማንም አይከራከር፤ ማንም ሌላውን አይገሥጽ፤ \q ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚከራከሩ ናቸውና።
am.B: ሆኖም ማንም ክስ አያቅርብ፤ ማንም ሌላውን አይወቅስ፤ \q ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚከራከሩ ሰዎች ናቸውና።
am.R: ነገር ግን ማንም ክስ አያቅርብ፤ ማንም ሌላውን አይውቀስ። \q ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚጣሉ ሰዎች ናቸው።

hi.L: फिर भी कोई मुक़दमा न करे, और कोई [दूसरे को] न डाँटे, \q क्योंकि तुम्हारी प्रजा याजक से वाद-विवाद करनेवालों के समान [है]।
hi.B: फिर भी कोई दोष न लगाए, और कोई दूसरे पर आरोप न लगाए, \q क्योंकि तुम्हारी प्रजा उन लोगों के समान है जो याजक से वाद-विवाद करते हैं।
hi.R: पर किसी को दोष लगाने या दूसरे पर इल्ज़ाम धरने न दो। \q तुम्हारे लोग उनके समान हैं जो याजक से बहस करते हैं।

ru.L: Однако пусть никто не судится, и пусть никто не обличает другого, \q ведь твой народ — как спорящие со священником.
ru.B: Но пусть никто не предъявляет обвинений и пусть никто не упрекает другого, \q ведь твой народ подобен тем, кто спорит со священником.
ru.R: Но пусть никто не обвиняет и не винит другого. \q Твой народ похож на тех, кто спорит со священником.

ja.L: しかし、だれも訴えるな。だれも責めるな。 \q あなたの民は、祭司と争う者たちのようだからだ。
ja.B: しかし、だれも訴えてはならない。だれも人を責めてはならない。 \q あなたの民は、祭司と争う者たちのようだからだ。
ja.R: しかし、だれも人を訴えたり、責めたりしてはいけない。 \q あなたの民は、祭司に言い逆らう者たちのようだ。

decisions.choice: your people are like those who contend with a priest (the Hebrew text as it stands)
alternatives: for with you is my case, O priest
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard. As it stands, it says that the people are like those who defy a priest, which the law treated as a grave offense (Deuteronomy 17:12): they will not accept correction, so it is useless for anyone to accuse them. A small change in the Hebrew letters and division of words would give "with you is my case, priest", which leads straight into the charge against the priest in verses 5-6. The translation follows the text as it stands; the change is a modern guess, not a reading found in a Hebrew manuscript.

decisions.choice: your: the priest, who is addressed in verses 4-6
decisions.reason: "You" in verses 4-6 is singular, and verse 6 speaks to one who was to serve as priest. The priest is addressed as the one responsible for the people, perhaps the chief priest of the northern shrines, and through him the priesthood as a whole.

decisions.choice: let no one bring a case or reprove another: blaming one another is useless
decisions.reason: The verbs are the language of the court ("contend" is the word for the LORD's case in verse 1). People may not shift the blame to one another, because all are guilty; the LORD's own charge comes next, against the priest.

decisions.choice: argue against a priest
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for contending in a dispute, and keeps the comparison as it stands in the Hebrew text (m1).

decisions.choice: "tu pueblo" (tú)
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 speak to a priest, one man, so Spanish uses tú.

decisions.choice: the priest addressed as "ngươi"
decisions.reason: God rebukes the priest of verses 4-6, so the terms note's "ngươi" of rebuke holds at every level.

decisions.choice: o teu povo; tu (verses 4-6, God to the priest)
decisions.reason: The "you" of verses 4-6 is singular, the priest addressed as the one responsible for the people (m2), so God speaks to him with "tu" at every level, as he speaks to one person throughout the Old Testament.

decisions.choice: "ሕዝብህ", "አንተ": the LORD addresses the priest in the singular (4:4-6)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes "your" as the priest, who is spoken to in verses 4-6; Amharic uses the familiar singular, as God speaks to Israel and its leaders through Hosea.

decisions.choice: तुम (the priest addressed)
decisions.reason: The LORD addresses the priest in 4:4-6; God addressing a person uses तुम.

decisions.choice: "your people" (m2: the priest is addressed in 4:4-6) "あなたの民", singular; prohibitions "〜するな" (L), "〜してはならない" (B), "〜してはいけない" (R), as Isaiah.
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions; the singular keeps the priest in view.

source.text: וְכָשַׁלְתָּ֣ הַיּ֔וֹם וְכָשַׁ֧ל גַּם־נָבִ֛יא עִמְּךָ֖ לָ֑יְלָה וְדָמִ֖יתִי אִמֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will stumble [by] the day, and will stumble also [the] prophet with you [by] night; and I will destroy your mother.

en.L: And you will stumble by day, \q and the prophet also will stumble with you by night; \q and I will destroy your mother.
en.B: By day you will stumble, \q and by night the prophet will stumble with you, \q and I will destroy your mother.
en.R: You will fall during the day, \q and the prophet will fall with you at night. \q And I will destroy your mother.

es.L: Y tropezarás de día, \q y tropezará también contigo el profeta de noche; \q y destruiré a tu madre.
es.B: De día tropezarás, \q y de noche tropezará contigo el profeta, \q y destruiré a tu madre.
es.R: Caerás durante el día, \q y el profeta caerá contigo durante la noche. \q Y destruiré a tu madre.

fr.L: Et tu trébucheras le jour, \q et le prophète aussi trébuchera avec toi la nuit ; \q et je détruirai ta mère.
fr.B: Le jour, tu trébucheras, \q et la nuit, le prophète trébuchera avec toi, \q et je détruirai ta mère.
fr.R: Tu tomberas pendant le jour, \q et le prophète tombera avec toi pendant la nuit. \q Et je détruirai ta mère.

ko.L: 너는 낮에 넘어지고, \q 예언자도 밤에 너와 함께 넘어질 것이다. \q 그리고 내가 네 어머니를 멸하겠다.
ko.B: 너는 낮에 넘어지고, \q 예언자도 밤에 너와 함께 넘어질 것이다. \q 내가 네 어머니를 멸망시키겠다.
ko.R: 너는 대낮에 쓰러질 것이다. \q 예언자도 밤에 너와 함께 쓰러질 것이다. \q 나는 네 어머니를 망하게 하겠다.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ vấp ngã ban ngày, \q và nhà tiên tri cũng sẽ vấp ngã với ngươi ban đêm; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt mẹ ngươi.
vi.B: Ban ngày ngươi sẽ vấp ngã, \q ban đêm nhà tiên tri cũng sẽ vấp ngã với ngươi, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt mẹ ngươi.
vi.R: Ngươi sẽ ngã quỵ giữa ban ngày, \q và nhà tiên tri sẽ ngã quỵ với ngươi lúc ban đêm. \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt mẹ ngươi.

sw.L: Nawe utajikwaa mchana, \q naye nabii pia atajikwaa pamoja nawe usiku; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwangamiza mama yako.
sw.B: Mchana utajikwaa, \q na usiku nabii atajikwaa pamoja nawe, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwangamiza mama yako.
sw.R: Utaanguka wakati wa mchana, \q na nabii ataanguka pamoja nawe usiku. \q Nami nitamwangamiza mama yako.

pt.L: E tropeçarás de dia, \q e também o profeta tropeçará contigo de noite; \q e destruirei a tua mãe.
pt.B: De dia tu tropeçarás, \q e de noite o profeta tropeçará contigo, \q e eu destruirei a tua mãe.
pt.R: Tu vais cair durante o dia, \q e o profeta vai cair contigo de noite. \q E eu vou destruir a tua mãe.

am.L: በቀንም ትሰናከላለህ፤ \q ነቢዩም ደግሞ ከአንተ ጋር በሌሊት ይሰናከላል፤ \q እናትህንም አጠፋለሁ።
am.B: በቀን ትሰናከላለህ፤ \q በሌሊትም ነቢዩ ከአንተ ጋር ይሰናከላል፤ \q እናትህንም አጠፋለሁ።
am.R: ቀን ትወድቃለህ፤ \q ነቢዩም ሌሊት ከአንተ ጋር ይወድቃል። \q እናትህንም አጠፋለሁ።

hi.L: और तुम दिन को ठोकर खाओगे, \q और भविष्यद्वक्ता भी रात को तुम्हारे साथ ठोकर खाएगा; \q और मैं तुम्हारी माता को नाश कर दूँगा।
hi.B: दिन में तुम ठोकर खाओगे, \q और रात में भविष्यद्वक्ता तुम्हारे साथ ठोकर खाएगा, \q और मैं तुम्हारी माता को नाश कर दूँगा।
hi.R: दिन में तुम गिर पड़ोगे, \q और रात में नबी तुम्हारे साथ गिर पड़ेगा। \q और मैं तुम्हारी माँ को नाश कर दूँगा।

ru.L: И споткнёшься ты днём, \q и споткнётся также пророк с тобой ночью; \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю твою мать.
ru.B: Днём ты будешь спотыкаться, \q и ночью вместе с тобой будет спотыкаться пророк, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю твою мать.
ru.R: Ты упадёшь днём, \q и пророк упадёт вместе с тобой ночью. \q И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} погублю твою мать.

ja.L: あなたは昼につまずき、 \q 預言者もまた夜、あなたと共につまずく。 \q わたしはあなたの母を滅ぼす。
ja.B: 昼にあなたはつまずき、 \q 夜には預言者もあなたと共につまずく。 \q わたしはあなたの母を滅ぼす。
ja.R: あなたは昼間に倒れ、 \q 預言者も夜に、あなたと一緒に倒れる。 \q わたしはあなたの母を滅ぼす。

decisions.choice: stumble: fall into disaster
decisions.reason: To stumble is to trip and fall, a common picture for coming to ruin (5:5; 14:2; Isaiah 8:15; Jeremiah 6:21). Day and night together mean that there is no time when priest and prophet are safe.

decisions.choice: the prophet: prophets who served alongside the priests at the shrines
decisions.reason: Priest and prophet were the two guides of the people, and both are condemned together (Isaiah 28:7; Jeremiah 6:13). These are not true prophets like Hosea but those who served at Israel's shrines and told the people what they wanted to hear (9:7-8).

decisions.choice: your mother: Israel, the nation as the mother of its people
alternatives: your mother: the priest's own family line
decisions.reason: In 2:4 "your mother" is Israel, the unfaithful wife whose children are the people. Here the priest's "mother" may be the nation he belongs to, or his own family and line, whose priesthood is to end (verse 6). The verb "destroy" (or "silence", "cut off") comes again in verse 6: "my people are destroyed".

decisions.choice: fall
decisions.reason: Readable says "fall", the everyday result of stumbling, which keeps the picture of coming to ruin (m1).

decisions.choice: "예언자"
decisions.reason: The modern word settled for the Korean Bible; 선지자 is the older Protestant word.

decisions.choice: भविष्यद्वक्ता (L, B); नबी (R)
decisions.reason: The prophet is भविष्यद्वक्ता at Literal and Balanced and नबी at Readable, as the style guide sets for the whole Bible.

source.text: נִדְמ֥וּ עַמִּ֖י מִבְּלִ֣י הַדָּ֑עַת כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה הַדַּ֣עַת מָאַ֗סְתָּ וְאֶמְאָֽסְאךָ֙ מִכַּהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וַתִּשְׁכַּח֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח בָּנֶ֖יךָ גַּם־אָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Are destroyed my people for lack of the knowledge; because you the knowledge have rejected, and I will reject you from serving as priest to me; and you have forgotten [the] instruction of your God, I will forget your sons, also I.

en.L: My people are destroyed for lack of the knowledge; \q because you have rejected the knowledge, I will reject you from serving as priest to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q and since you have forgotten the instruction of your God, \q I also will forget your {{gender:children|sons}}.
en.B: My people are perishing for lack of knowledge. \q Since you have rejected knowledge, I reject you as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} priest; \q since you have forgotten the instruction of your God, \q I too will forget your {{gender:children|sons}}.
en.R: My people are being destroyed because they do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q You have refused to know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so I refuse to have you as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} priest. \q You have forgotten the teaching of your God, \q so I will forget your {{gender:children|sons}}.

es.L: Mi pueblo es destruido por falta de conocimiento; \q porque tú rechazaste el conocimiento, yo te rechazaré para que no seas sacerdote para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q y porque olvidaste la instrucción de tu Dios, \q también yo me olvidaré de tus hijos.
es.B: Mi pueblo perece por falta de conocimiento. \q Puesto que tú has rechazado el conocimiento, yo te rechazo como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacerdote; \q puesto que has olvidado la instrucción de tu Dios, \q también yo me olvidaré de tus hijos.
es.R: Mi pueblo está siendo destruido porque no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoce. \q Tú no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has querido conocer, así que yo me niego a tenerte como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacerdote. \q Has olvidado la enseñanza de tu Dios, \q así que yo me olvidaré de tus hijos.

fr.L: Mon peuple est détruit faute de la connaissance ; \q puisque toi, tu as rejeté la connaissance, je te rejetterai pour que tu ne sois plus prêtre pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q et puisque tu as oublié la loi de ton Dieu, \q {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi, j’oublierai tes {{gender:enfants|fils}}.
fr.B: Mon peuple périt faute de connaissance. \q Puisque tu as rejeté la connaissance, je te rejette : tu ne seras plus {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} prêtre ; \q puisque tu as oublié l’instruction de ton Dieu, \q {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi, j’oublierai tes {{gender:enfants|fils}}.
fr.R: Mon peuple est détruit parce qu’il ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaît pas. \q Tu as refusé de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître, alors je refuse de t’avoir comme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} prêtre. \q Tu as oublié l’enseignement de ton Dieu, \q alors j’oublierai tes {{gender:enfants|fils}}.

ko.L: 내 백성이 지식이 없어서 망한다. \q 네가 지식을 버렸으니, 나도 너를 버려 나에게 제사장 노릇을 하지 못하게 하겠다. \q 네가 네 하나님의 가르침을 잊었으니, \q 나도 네 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 잊겠다.
ko.B: 내 백성이 지식이 없어서 망해 간다. \q 네가 지식을 저버렸으니, 나도 너를 저버려 내 제사장이 되지 못하게 하겠다. \q 네가 네 하나님의 가르침을 잊었으니, \q 나도 네 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 잊겠다.
ko.R: 내 백성이 나를 알지 못해서 망해 가고 있다. \q 너는 나를 알려고 하지 않았다. 그러니 나도 너를 내 제사장으로 두지 않겠다. \q 너는 네 하나님의 가르침을 잊어버렸다. \q 그러니 나도 네 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 잊어버리겠다.

vi.L: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bị diệt vong vì thiếu sự hiểu biết; \q vì ngươi đã khước từ sự hiểu biết, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khước từ ngươi, không cho làm thầy tế lễ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q và vì ngươi đã quên lời dạy dỗ của Đức Chúa Trời ngươi, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ quên con cái ngươi.
vi.B: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bị diệt vong vì thiếu sự hiểu biết. \q Vì ngươi đã khước từ sự hiểu biết, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khước từ ngươi, không cho làm thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa; \q vì ngươi đã quên lời dạy dỗ của Đức Chúa Trời ngươi, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ quên con cái ngươi.
vi.R: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang bị hủy diệt vì không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ngươi đã không chịu biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không chịu để ngươi làm thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ngươi đã quên lời dạy của Đức Chúa Trời ngươi, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quên con cái ngươi.

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wameangamizwa kwa kukosa maarifa; \q kwa sababu wewe umeyakataa maarifa, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakukataa usiwe kuhani {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}; \q na kwa kuwa umeisahau sheria ya Mungu wako, \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia nitawasahau wana wako.
sw.B: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanaangamia kwa kukosa maarifa. \q Kwa kuwa umeyakataa maarifa, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ninakukataa usiwe kuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; \q kwa kuwa umesahau mafundisho ya Mungu wako, \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia nitawasahau wana wako.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanaangamizwa kwa sababu hawanijui. \q Umekataa kunijua, kwa hiyo ninakataa uwe kuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Umesahau mafundisho ya Mungu wako, \q kwa hiyo nitawasahau wana wako.

pt.L: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo é destruído por falta do conhecimento; \q porque tu rejeitaste o conhecimento, eu te rejeitarei, para que não sejas sacerdote para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q e, porque te esqueceste da instrução do teu Deus, \q também eu me esquecerei dos teus filhos.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo está perecendo por falta de conhecimento. \q Porque rejeitaste o conhecimento, eu te rejeito como {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sacerdote; \q porque te esqueceste da instrução do teu Deus, \q também eu me esquecerei dos teus filhos.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo está sendo destruído porque não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhece. \q Tu te recusaste a {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecer, por isso eu me recuso a te aceitar como {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sacerdote. \q Tu te esqueceste do ensino do teu Deus, \q por isso eu vou me esquecer dos teus filhos.

am.L: ሕዝቤ እውቀት በማጣት ጠፍቷል፤ \q አንተ እውቀትን ስለ ጣልህ እኔም ካህን እንዳትሆነኝ እጥልሃለሁ፤ \q የአምላክህንም ሕግ ስለ ረሳህ፣ \q እኔም ደግሞ ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።
am.B: ሕዝቤ እውቀት በማጣቱ እየጠፋ ነው። \q አንተ እውቀትን ስለ ጣልህ እኔም ካህኔ እንዳትሆን ጥዬሃለሁ፤ \q የአምላክህን ሕግ ስለ ረሳህ \q እኔም ደግሞ ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።
am.R: ሕዝቤ እኔን ስለማያውቁ እየጠፉ ነው። \q አንተ እኔን ማወቅ እምቢ ስላልክ እኔም ካህኔ እንድትሆን እምቢ እላለሁ። \q የአምላክህን ትምህርት ረሳህ፤ \q ስለዚህ እኔም ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።

hi.L: मेरी प्रजा ज्ञान की कमी से नाश होती है; \q क्योंकि तुमने ज्ञान को ठुकराया है, मैं भी तुम्हें ठुकराऊँगा कि तुम मेरे लिए याजक न रहो; \q और क्योंकि तुम अपने परमेश्वर की शिक्षा को भूल गए हो, \q मैं भी तुम्हारी {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} को भूल जाऊँगा।
hi.B: मेरी प्रजा ज्ञान के अभाव में नाश हो रही है। \q क्योंकि तुमने ज्ञान को ठुकरा दिया है, इसलिए मैं तुम्हें अपने याजक के रूप में ठुकराता हूँ; \q क्योंकि तुम अपने परमेश्वर की शिक्षा को भूल गए हो, \q मैं भी तुम्हारी {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} को भूल जाऊँगा।
hi.R: मेरे लोग नाश हो रहे हैं, क्योंकि वे मुझे नहीं जानते। \q तुमने मुझे जानने से इनकार किया है, इसलिए मैं तुम्हें अपना याजक रखने से इनकार करता हूँ। \q तुम अपने परमेश्वर की शिक्षा को भूल गए हो, \q इसलिए मैं तुम्हारी {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} को भूल जाऊँगा।

ru.L: Погибает {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ от недостатка знания; \q так как ты отверг знание, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отвергну тебя от священнослужения {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}; \q и так как ты забыл наставление своего Бога, \q забуду и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} твоих {{gender:детей|сыновей}}.
ru.B: Мой народ гибнет от недостатка знания. \q Раз ты отверг знание, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отвергаю тебя как {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} священника; \q раз ты забыл наставление своего Бога, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} забуду твоих {{gender:детей|сыновей}}.
ru.R: Мой народ гибнет, потому что не знает {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Ты не захотел знать {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, поэтому и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не хочу, чтобы ты был {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} священником. \q Ты забыл наставление своего Бога, \q поэтому и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} забуду твоих {{gender:детей|сыновей}}.

ja.L: わたしの民は知識がないために滅ぼされる。 \q あなたが知識を退けたので、わたしもあなたを退けて、わたしの祭司としない。 \q あなたがあなたの神の教えを忘れたので、 \q わたしもまた、あなたの子らを忘れる。
ja.B: わたしの民は知識がないために滅びていく。 \q あなたが知識を退けたので、わたしもあなたを退け、わたしの祭司とはしない。 \q あなたがあなたの神の教えを忘れたので、 \q わたしもあなたの子らを忘れる。
ja.R: わたしの民は、わたしを知らないために滅ぼされていく。 \q あなたがわたしを知ろうとしなかったので、わたしもあなたを、わたしの祭司とは認めない。 \q あなたは、自分の神の教えを忘れた。 \q だから、わたしもあなたの子どもたちを忘れる。

decisions.choice: knowledge: the knowledge of God of verse 1
decisions.reason: The word has the article, "the knowledge": the knowledge already named in verse 1, of God and of what he has taught (see 4:1). The priests were charged with teaching the LORD's instruction to the people (Leviticus 10:11; Deuteronomy 33:10; Malachi 2:7). Because the priest has rejected it, the people perish for lack of it.

decisions.choice: you have rejected ... I will reject you: the punishment matches the sin
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice, and so is "forget" in the second half: the LORD answers the priest's rejection and forgetting with his own. Rejection "from serving as priest" means losing the priesthood.

decisions.choice: instruction (torah): the LORD's teaching, which the priests were to pass on
decisions.reason: Torah is instruction or teaching, including the written law (8:12). The priests were its keepers and teachers (Jeremiah 18:18; Malachi 2:6-7).

decisions.choice: I will forget your sons: the priest's line will lose the priesthood
decisions.reason: The priesthood passed from father to son. If the LORD "forgets" the priest's sons, they will not follow him as priests, and his line will end (compare 1 Samuel 2:30-33).

decisions.choice: are destroyed: are cut off, perish
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 5, "I will destroy your mother". It can mean to be silenced or cut off; here it means that the people perish (10:7, 15).

decisions.choice: because they do not know me ... You have refused to know me
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the knowledge is of, since the knowledge meant is the knowledge of God (m1, and 4:1).

decisions.choice: your children (sons as the setting's alternative)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons" refers to the priest's descendants. The priesthood passed to sons, so the traditional form is kept as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "la instrucción" (L, B); "la enseñanza" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah as the Spanish prophets have it (Isaiah note).

decisions.choice: *torah* is "가르침" at every level
decisions.reason: The instruction the priests were to pass on; "가르침" as the English "instruction" and as Jeremiah, keeping "율법" for the written law of Moses.

decisions.choice: "네 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들"
decisions.reason: The priest's children; Korean has two wordings here, so the English gender span is kept.

decisions.choice: "lời dạy dỗ" (L, B); "lời dạy" (R) for torah
decisions.reason: As published in Isaiah 1:10 for torah in the prophets: the priests' teaching, not only the written law. "Con cái" covers sons and daughters, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: *torah* "sheria" (L); "mafundisho" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms and Isaiah notes: the LORD's teaching that the priests were to pass on (m3).

decisions.choice: "watu wangu" with a span on "wangu"; "wana wako" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has no span on sentence-initial "My", but in Swahili the possessive follows the noun and is a free word, so it takes the span. "Wana" covers sons and daughters (see 2:1).

decisions.choice: God's torah: "la loi" (L), "l'instruction" (B), "l'enseignement" (R), throughout Hosea
decisions.reason: As the term sheet carries over from Isaiah and Jeremiah: the word is God's teaching, which the priests were to pass on; "la Loi" with a capital is kept for the Law of Moses.

decisions.choice: a instrução (L, B), o ensino (R); os teus filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Torah, the teaching the priests were to pass on (m3), takes the words Jeremiah 2:8 sets in Portuguese: "a instrução" at Literal and Balanced, "o ensino" at Readable. "Filhos" already takes in daughters, so the English gender setting has no Portuguese counterpart (2:1). God's own "meu" in "o meu povo" takes the deity_pronoun span, as elsewhere in the chapter.

decisions.choice: शिक्षा (torah)
decisions.reason: Torah in the Prophets is God's teaching through priest and prophet; it is शिक्षा at every level, as settled for the Prophets (Isaiah 1:10).

decisions.choice: наставление (every level)
decisions.reason: Torah in the Prophets is "наставление" at every level, as the Prophets note settles: the LORD's teaching, which the priests were to pass on (m3).

decisions.choice: детей / сыновей (gender setting)
decisions.reason: The priest's descendants are meant (m4), so the gender setting is used, as in the English.

decisions.choice: hadda'at "the knowledge" (m1: the knowledge of God of 4:1) "知識" (L, B), "わたしを知らない" / "わたしを知ろうとしなかった" (R, as the English Readable); torah "教え" at every level, as the prophetic conventions (not 律法). The English gender span on "children / sons" needs none in Japanese ("子ら", "子どもたち").
decisions.reason: The knowing of God stays a verb at Readable, as in 4:1.
