records.literal_gloss: As they increased, so they sinned against me; their glory into shame I will change.

en.L: As they increased, so they sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q I will exchange their glory for shame.
en.B: The more they increased, the more they sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q I will turn their glory into shame.
en.R: The more of them there were, the more they sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q So I will turn their glory into shame.

es.L: Cuanto más se multiplicaron, tanto más pecaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q cambiaré su gloria en deshonra.
es.B: Cuanto más crecieron, más pecaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q convertiré su gloria en deshonra.
es.R: Cuantos más eran, más pecaban contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Por eso convertiré su gloria en vergüenza.

fr.L: Selon qu’ils se sont multipliés, ainsi ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q j’échangerai leur gloire contre la honte.
fr.B: Plus ils se sont multipliés, plus ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q je changerai leur gloire en honte.
fr.R: Plus ils sont devenus nombreux, plus ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Alors je changerai leur gloire en honte.

ko.L: 그들이 많아질수록 그만큼 나에게 죄를 지었다. \q 내가 그들의 영광을 수치로 바꾸겠다.
ko.B: 그들이 많아지면 많아질수록 나에게 더 많은 죄를 지었다. \q 내가 그들의 영광을 수치로 바꾸겠다.
ko.R: 그들은 수가 많아질수록 나에게 더 많은 죄를 지었다. \q 그러니 나는 그들의 영광을 부끄러움으로 바꾸겠다.

vi.L: Chúng càng gia tăng, chúng càng phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổi vinh quang của chúng ra sỉ nhục.
vi.B: Chúng càng đông thêm, chúng càng phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ biến vinh quang của chúng thành sỉ nhục.
vi.R: Chúng càng đông, chúng càng phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ biến vinh quang của chúng thành nỗi nhục.

sw.L: Kadiri walivyoongezeka, ndivyo walivyonitenda dhambi; \q nitaubadilisha utukufu wao kuwa aibu.
sw.B: Kadiri walivyozidi kuwa wengi, ndivyo walivyozidi kunitenda dhambi; \q nitaugeuza utukufu wao kuwa aibu.
sw.R: Kadiri walivyozidi kuwa wengi, ndivyo walivyozidi kunikosea. \q Kwa hiyo nitaugeuza utukufu wao kuwa aibu.

pt.L: Conforme eles se multiplicaram, assim pecaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q trocarei a glória deles por vergonha.
pt.B: Quanto mais eles se multiplicaram, mais pecaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q transformarei a glória deles em vergonha.
pt.R: Quanto mais numerosos eles ficaram, mais pecaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Por isso vou transformar a glória deles em vergonha.

am.L: በበዙ መጠን እንዲሁ በእኔ ላይ ኃጢአት ሠሩ፤ \q ክብራቸውን በኀፍረት እለውጣለሁ።
am.B: በበዙ ቁጥር በእኔ ላይ የሚሠሩት ኃጢአት በዛ፤ \q ክብራቸውን ወደ ኀፍረት እለውጣለሁ።
am.R: ቁጥራቸው በበዛ መጠን በእኔ ላይ የሚሠሩት ኃጢአትም በዛ። \q ስለዚህ ክብራቸውን ወደ ኀፍረት እለውጣለሁ።

hi.L: जैसे-जैसे वे बढ़ते गए, वैसे-वैसे वे मेरे विरुद्ध पाप करते गए; \q मैं उनकी महिमा को अपमान से बदल दूँगा।
hi.B: वे जितने बढ़ते गए, उतना ही मेरे विरुद्ध पाप करते गए; \q मैं उनकी महिमा को लज्जा में बदल दूँगा।
hi.R: वे जितने अधिक हुए, उतना ही अधिक उन्होंने मेरे विरुद्ध पाप किया। \q इसलिए मैं उनकी महिमा को लज्जा में बदल दूँगा।

ru.L: Как они умножились, так согрешили против {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}; \q славу их {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заменю позором.
ru.B: Чем больше их становилось, тем больше они грешили против {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} обращу их славу в позор.
ru.R: Чем больше их становилось, тем больше они грешили против {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} превращу их славу в позор.

ja.L: 彼らが増えるにつれて、ますますわたしに罪を犯した。 \q わたしは彼らの栄光を恥と取り替える。
ja.B: 彼らは増えれば増えるほど、わたしに罪を犯した。 \q わたしは彼らの栄光を恥に変える。
ja.R: 彼らは数が増えれば増えるほど、わたしに罪を犯した。 \q だから、わたしは彼らの栄光を恥に変える。

decisions.choice: as they increased, so they sinned: the more they grew, the more they sinned
decisions.reason: "They" may be the priests, whose numbers grew with the shrines, or the people as a whole, who grew in number and wealth (10:1). In either case growth brought more sin, not more thankfulness.

decisions.choice: I will exchange their glory for shame (the Hebrew text as it stands)
alternatives: they have exchanged my glory for shame
decisions.reason: An old Jewish scribal tradition lists this verse among a few places where the scribes are said to have changed the wording out of reverence, and gives the earlier reading as "they have exchanged my glory for shame", that is, they traded the LORD, their glory, for a shameful idol (Psalm 106:20; Jeremiah 2:11). The translation follows the Hebrew text as it stands. Their "glory" is their honor, perhaps their priesthood itself; "shame" may also hint at Baal, whose name was sometimes replaced by the word for shame (9:10).

source.text: חַטַּ֥את עַמִּ֖י יֹאכֵ֑לוּ וְאֶל־עֲוֺנָ֖ם יִשְׂא֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sin of my people they eat, and to their iniquity they lift up his desire.

en.L: They feed on the sin of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q and to their iniquity they lift up their appetite.
en.B: They feed on the sin of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q and set their appetite on their guilt.
en.R: The priests eat the offerings {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people bring for their sins, \q so they want them to sin more and more.

es.L: Del pecado de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo se alimentan, \q y hacia su iniquidad dirigen su apetito.
es.B: Se alimentan del pecado de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q y ponen su apetito en su culpa.
es.R: Los sacerdotes se comen las ofrendas que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo trae por sus pecados, \q y por eso quieren que peque más y más.

fr.L: Ils se nourrissent du péché de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q et vers leur iniquité ils élèvent leur désir.
fr.B: Ils se nourrissent du péché de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q et leur appétit se porte sur sa faute.
fr.R: Les prêtres mangent les offrandes que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple apporte pour ses péchés, \q alors ils veulent que le peuple pèche de plus en plus.

ko.L: 그들은 내 백성의 죄를 먹고 산다. \q 그들의 죄악에 그들의 욕심을 둔다.
ko.B: 그들은 내 백성의 죄를 먹고 살면서, \q 백성이 죄를 짓기를 바란다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 내 백성이 죄 때문에 바치는 제물을 먹는다. \q 그래서 그들은 백성이 죄를 더 많이 짓기를 바란다.

vi.L: Chúng ăn tội lỗi của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và hướng lòng thèm muốn của mình về sự gian ác của dân.
vi.B: Chúng nuôi thân bằng tội lỗi của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và mong mỏi cho dân mắc thêm tội.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ ăn những của lễ dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dâng vì tội lỗi mình, \q nên chúng muốn dân phạm tội ngày càng nhiều.

sw.L: Wanakula dhambi ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q na kuinua tamaa yao kwa uovu wao.
sw.B: Wanajilisha kwa dhambi ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na kuielekeza tamaa yao kwenye hatia yao.
sw.R: Makuhani wanakula sadaka ambazo watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanazileta kwa ajili ya dhambi zao, \q kwa hiyo wanataka watu waendelee kutenda dhambi zaidi na zaidi.

pt.L: Eles se alimentam do pecado do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, \q e para a iniquidade dele levantam o seu desejo.
pt.B: Eles se alimentam do pecado do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q e põem o seu apetite na culpa dele.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes comem as ofertas que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo traz pelos seus pecados, \q e por isso querem que o povo peque cada vez mais.

am.L: የሕዝቤን ኃጢአት ይበላሉ፤ \q ምኞታቸውንም ወደ በደላቸው ያነሣሉ።
am.B: የሕዝቤን ኃጢአት ይመገባሉ፤ \q ምኞታቸውንም በበደላቸው ላይ አድርገዋል።
am.R: ካህናቱ ሕዝቤ ስለ ኃጢአታቸው የሚያቀርቡትን መሥዋዕት ይበላሉ፤ \q ስለዚህ ሕዝቡ ይበልጥ ኃጢአት እንዲሠራ ይመኛሉ።

hi.L: वे मेरी प्रजा के पाप को खाते हैं, \q और उनके अधर्म की ओर अपनी लालसा लगाते हैं।
hi.B: वे मेरी प्रजा के पाप पर पलते हैं \q और उनके दोष के लिए लालायित रहते हैं।
hi.R: याजक वे भेंटें खाते हैं जो मेरे लोग अपने पापों के लिए लाते हैं, \q इसलिए वे चाहते हैं कि लोग और भी अधिक पाप करें।

ru.L: Грехом {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа они питаются, \q и к беззаконию его устремляют свою душу.
ru.B: Они кормятся грехом {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа \q и жадно ждут его вины.
ru.R: Священники едят жертвы за грех, которые приносит {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, \q и поэтому хотят, чтобы народ грешил всё больше и больше.

ja.L: 彼らはわたしの民の罪を食べ、 \q 民の咎に自分の欲望を向ける。
ja.B: 彼らはわたしの民の罪を食い物にし、 \q 民の咎をむさぼるように求めている。
ja.R: 祭司たちは、わたしの民が罪のためにささげる物を食べる。 \q だから、民がもっともっと罪を犯すことを望んでいる。

decisions.choice: the sin of my people: both their sin and the sin offerings brought for it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "sin" is also the word for a "sin offering". The priests were given part of the sin offering to eat (Leviticus 6:19-22). So the more the people sinned, the more the priests ate. They profited from the people's sin instead of turning them from it.

decisions.choice: they lift up their appetite to their iniquity: they long for the people to sin
decisions.reason: To "lift up one's soul (or appetite) to" something is to long for it (Deuteronomy 24:15; Jeremiah 22:27). The Hebrew has "his" appetite: each priest's desire. "Their iniquity" is the people's iniquity.

decisions.choice: The priests eat the offerings my people bring for their sins, so they want them to sin more and more
decisions.reason: Readable names the priests and makes plain the double sense of "sin" (m1) and what the priests long for (m2), which the Hebrew leaves to the reader.

decisions.choice: iniquity (Literal), guilt (Balanced), sin (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word ('awon) in the prophets.
The English uses "guilt" at Balanced; Korean says it with the verb ("죄를 짓기를 바란다"), keeping the sense that the priests profit from the people's sin.

decisions.choice: o pecado (L, B); as ofertas ... pelos seus pecados (R); a iniquidade (L), a culpa (B), pecar (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "pecado" cannot also mean the sin offering, so Literal and Balanced keep "pecado" and leave the double sense to the note (m1), and Readable says it, as the English Readable does. 'Awon is "iniquidade" at Literal, "culpa" at Balanced and the plain "pecar" at Readable, as the English sets it (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: अधर्म (L); दोष (B); पाप (R)
decisions.reason: 'Awon is अधर्म at Literal and दोष at Balanced, as the Pentateuch note settles; Readable says पाप, as the English Readable says "sin".

decisions.choice: грех (every level); беззаконие (L), вина (B)
decisions.reason: "Sin" here is both the sin and the sin offering brought for it (m1); Readable says so, as the English Readable does. 'Awon is "беззаконие" at Literal and "вина" at Balanced, as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: 'avon "咎" (L, B), "罪" (R), and chatta't "罪", as Isaiah and the Psalms; chatta't keeps both senses, sin and sin offering (m1), at Literal and Balanced ("罪を食べる", "罪を食い物にする"); Readable spells out the offering as the English Readable.
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions for the words of sin.

source.text: וְהָיָ֥ה כָעָ֖ם כַּכֹּהֵ֑ן וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עָלָיו֙ דְּרָכָ֔יו וּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו אָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, like people like priest; and I will visit on him his ways, and his deeds I will return to him.

en.L: And it will be: like people, like priest; \q and I will punish him for his ways, \q and his deeds I will repay to him.
en.B: So it will be: like people, like priest. \q I will punish them for their ways \q and repay them for their deeds.
en.R: Priests and people will be treated alike. \q I will punish them for the way they live \q and pay them back for what they have done.

es.L: Y sucederá: como el pueblo, así el sacerdote; \q y le pediré cuentas por sus caminos, \q y le pagaré conforme a sus obras.
es.B: Así será: como el pueblo, así el sacerdote. \q Los castigaré por sus caminos \q y les pagaré por sus obras.
es.R: Los sacerdotes y el pueblo serán tratados igual. \q Los castigaré por su manera de vivir \q y les daré lo que merecen por lo que han hecho.

fr.L: Et il en sera : tel peuple, tel prêtre ; \q et je le punirai pour ses voies, \q et ses actions, je les lui rendrai.
fr.B: Il en sera ainsi : tel peuple, tel prêtre. \q Je les punirai pour leur conduite \q et je leur rendrai selon leurs actes.
fr.R: Les prêtres et le peuple seront traités de la même façon. \q Je les punirai pour leur manière de vivre \q et je leur ferai payer ce qu’ils ont fait.

ko.L: 그러므로 백성이나 제사장이나 똑같이 될 것이다. \q 내가 그의 행실대로 그를 벌하고, \q 그의 행위대로 그에게 갚겠다.
ko.B: 그래서 백성이나 제사장이나 다를 것이 없을 것이다. \q 내가 그들의 행실대로 그들을 벌하고, \q 그들이 한 일대로 갚겠다.
ko.R: 제사장과 백성이 똑같은 일을 당할 것이다. \q 나는 그들이 살아온 대로 그들을 벌하고, \q 그들이 한 대로 갚아 주겠다.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra: dân thế nào, thầy tế lễ thế ấy; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm phạt nó về đường lối nó, \q và việc làm của nó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ báo trả cho nó.
vi.B: Vì thế sẽ xảy ra: dân thế nào, thầy tế lễ thế ấy. \q Ta sẽ trừng phạt chúng về đường lối chúng \q và báo trả chúng về việc làm của chúng.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ và dân chúng sẽ bị đối xử như nhau. \q Ta sẽ trừng phạt chúng vì lối sống của chúng \q và báo trả chúng về những điều chúng đã làm.

sw.L: Na itakuwa: kama watu, ndivyo kuhani; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamwadhibu kwa njia zake, \q na matendo yake nitamlipa.
sw.B: Basi itakuwa hivi: kama walivyo watu, ndivyo alivyo kuhani. \q Nitawaadhibu kwa njia zao \q na kuwalipa kwa matendo yao.
sw.R: Makuhani na watu watatendewa sawa. \q Nitawaadhibu kwa jinsi wanavyoishi \q na kuwalipa kwa yale waliyoyatenda.

pt.L: E será: como o povo, [assim] o sacerdote; \q e eu o castigarei pelos seus caminhos, \q e lhe retribuirei as suas obras.
pt.B: Assim será: tal povo, tal sacerdote. \q Eu os castigarei pelos seus caminhos \q e lhes retribuirei as suas obras.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes e o povo vão ser tratados do mesmo jeito. \q Vou castigá-los pelo modo como vivem \q e vou dar a eles o que merecem pelo que fizeram.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እንደ ሕዝቡ እንዲሁ ካህኑ፤ \q ስለ መንገዱም እቀጣዋለሁ፤ \q ሥራውንም እመልስበታለሁ።
am.B: እንዲሁም ይሆናል፤ ሕዝቡ እንደ ሆነ ካህኑም እንዲሁ ነው። \q ስለ መንገዳቸው እቀጣቸዋለሁ፤ \q እንደ ሥራቸውም እከፍላቸዋለሁ።
am.R: ካህናቱና ሕዝቡ በአንድ ዓይነት ይታያሉ። \q ስለ አኗኗራቸው እቀጣቸዋለሁ፤ \q ስላደረጉትም ብድራታቸውን እከፍላቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा: जैसी प्रजा, वैसा याजक; \q और मैं उसके चालचलन का दंड उसे दूँगा, \q और उसके कामों का बदला उसे चुकाऊँगा।
hi.B: तो ऐसा होगा: जैसी प्रजा, वैसा याजक। \q मैं उन्हें उनके चालचलन का दंड दूँगा \q और उनके कामों का बदला उन्हें दूँगा।
hi.R: याजकों और लोगों के साथ एक ही जैसा व्यवहार होगा। \q मैं उन्हें उनके जीने के ढंग के लिए दंड दूँगा \q और जो उन्होंने किया है उसका बदला उन्हें चुकाऊँगा।

ru.L: И будет: каков народ, таков и священник; \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} взыщу с него за пути его, \q и дела его воздам ему.
ru.B: И будет так: каков народ, таков и священник. \q Я накажу их за их пути \q и воздам им за их дела.
ru.R: Со священниками и с народом будет одно и то же. \q Я накажу их за то, как они живут, \q и воздам им за то, что они сделали.

ja.L: こうして、民も祭司も同じようになる。 \q わたしは彼をその道のゆえに罰し、 \q その行いを彼に報いる。
ja.B: こうして、民も祭司も同じようになる。 \q わたしは彼らをその歩みのゆえに罰し、 \q その行いに報いる。
ja.R: 祭司も民も、同じように扱われる。 \q わたしは、彼らの生き方を罰し、 \q 彼らのしたことの報いを受けさせる。

decisions.choice: like people, like priest: priest and people will share the same judgment
decisions.reason: The priest, who should have been different from the people, has become like them, and will be treated like them. Isaiah 24:2 uses the same pattern for a judgment that spares no class.

decisions.choice: him ... his ways ... his deeds: each one, priest and people alike
decisions.reason: The pronouns are singular. They may point to the priest, or to everyone, priest and people, taken one by one.

decisions.choice: visit on: punish
decisions.reason: "Visit (sins) on" someone means to call them to account and punish them (1:4; 2:15; 8:13).

decisions.choice: them ... their
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plural pronouns, because the singular here covers priest and people alike (m2).

decisions.choice: tal povo, tal sacerdote
alternatives: como o povo, assim o sacerdote
decisions.reason: Portuguese has its own form for a saying of this shape, "tal ... tal ...", as Ezekiel 16:44 has "tal mãe, tal filha"; Balanced uses it, and Literal keeps the Hebrew "como ... [assim] ...".

decisions.choice: paqad 'al "visit on" "罰する" at every level (m3), as 1:4 and 2:15; "like people, like priest" "民も祭司も同じようになる" (L, B).
decisions.reason: One verb for the LORD's "visiting" in judgment through the book.

source.text: וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔עוּ הִזְנ֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יִפְרֹ֑צוּ כִּֽי־אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה עָזְב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will eat and not be satisfied; they will prostitute [themselves] and not increase; for Yahweh they have forsaken to keep.

en.L: And they will eat and not be satisfied; \q they will prostitute themselves and not increase, \q because they have forsaken heeding {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They will eat but not be satisfied; \q they will prostitute themselves but not increase, \q because they have stopped heeding {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They will eat but still be hungry. \q They will be unfaithful, but they will not have more children, \q because they have stopped obeying {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y comerán, pero no se saciarán; \q se prostituirán, pero no se multiplicarán, \q porque han dejado de hacer caso {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Comerán, pero no quedarán satisfechos; \q se prostituirán, pero no se multiplicarán, \q porque han dejado de hacer caso {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Comerán, pero seguirán con hambre. \q Serán infieles, pero no tendrán más hijos, \q porque han dejado de obedecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils mangeront et ne seront pas rassasiés ; \q ils se prostitueront et ne se multiplieront pas, \q car ils ont abandonné [le soin] d’être attentifs {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils mangeront sans être rassasiés ; \q ils se prostitueront sans se multiplier, \q car ils ont cessé d’être attentifs {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ils mangeront, mais ils auront encore faim. \q Ils seront infidèles, mais ils n’auront pas plus d’enfants, \q parce qu’ils ont cessé d’obéir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그들이 먹어도 배부르지 않고, \q 음행해도 불어나지 않을 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버리고 [그 말에] 귀 기울이지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들은 먹어도 배부르지 않고, \q 음행해도 자손이 불어나지 않을 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버리고 귀 기울이지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들은 먹어도 여전히 배고플 것이다. \q 신실하지 않은 짓을 해도 자녀를 더 낳지 못할 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버리고 순종하지 않았기 때문이다.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ ăn mà không no; \q chúng sẽ làm điếm mà không sinh sôi, \q vì chúng đã lìa bỏ việc lưu tâm đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ ăn nhưng không no; \q chúng sẽ làm điếm nhưng không thêm đông, \q vì chúng đã thôi lắng nghe {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ ăn nhưng vẫn đói. \q Chúng sẽ bất trung, nhưng không có thêm con cái, \q vì chúng đã thôi vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

sw.L: Nao watakula lakini hawatashiba; \q watafanya ukahaba lakini hawataongezeka, \q kwa sababu wameacha kumsikiliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watakula lakini hawatashiba; \q watafanya ukahaba lakini hawataongezeka, \q kwa sababu wameacha kumjali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watakula lakini bado watakuwa na njaa. \q Wataendelea kutokuwa waaminifu, lakini hawatapata watoto zaidi, \q kwa sababu wameacha kumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

pt.L: E comerão e não se fartarão; \q se prostituirão e não se multiplicarão, \q porque deixaram de dar atenção {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Comerão, mas não ficarão satisfeitos; \q eles se prostituirão, mas não se multiplicarão, \q porque deixaram de dar atenção {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Eles vão comer, mas vão continuar com fome. \q Vão ser infiéis, mas não vão ter mais filhos, \q porque deixaram de obedecer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ይበላሉ፤ ግን አይጠግቡም፤ \q ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ ግን አይበዙም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መስማት ትተዋልና።
am.B: ይበላሉ፤ ግን አይጠግቡም፤ \q ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ ግን አይበዙም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መስማት ትተዋልና።
am.R: ይበላሉ፤ ግን አሁንም ይራባሉ። \q ታማኝነታቸውን ያጓድላሉ፤ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አይኖራቸውም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መታዘዝ ትተዋልና።

hi.L: और वे खाएँगे पर तृप्त न होंगे; \q वे वेश्यावृत्ति करेंगे पर बढ़ेंगे नहीं, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर ध्यान देना छोड़ दिया है।
hi.B: वे खाएँगे, पर तृप्त न होंगे; \q वे वेश्यावृत्ति करेंगे, पर बढ़ेंगे नहीं, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात पर ध्यान देना छोड़ दिया है।
hi.R: वे खाएँगे, पर फिर भी भूखे रहेंगे। \q वे बेवफ़ाई करेंगे, पर उनके और बच्चे नहीं होंगे, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात मानना छोड़ दिया है।

ru.L: И будут они есть, но не насытятся; \q будут блудить, но не умножатся, \q потому что оставили они слушание {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Они будут есть, но не насытятся; \q будут блудить, но не умножатся, \q потому что перестали слушаться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Они будут есть, но останутся голодными. \q Они будут изменять, но у них не будет больше детей, \q потому что перестали слушаться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 彼らは食べても満ち足りず、 \q 淫行をしても増えない。 \q 彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に心を留めることを捨てたからだ。
ja.B: 彼らは食べても満たされず、 \q 淫行にふけっても増えない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に心を留めることをやめてしまったからだ。
ja.R: 彼らは食べても、まだおなかがすく。 \q 不誠実なことをしても、子どもは増えない。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に従うことをやめてしまったからだ。

decisions.choice: prostitute themselves (zanah): unfaithfulness to the LORD in the worship of other gods, here including the sexual rites of that worship
decisions.reason: The verb means to act as a prostitute, to have sex outside marriage. Hosea uses it above all for Israel's unfaithfulness to the LORD, pictured as a wife's unfaithfulness to her husband (1:2; 2:4-7; Judges 2:17; Jeremiah 3:1). In chapter 4 the picture and the reality meet: worship at the hill shrines included sexual acts (verses 13-14), so the word covers both the people's turning to other gods and the immorality that went with it. This note applies to the verb and its nouns in 4:10-18 and 5:3-4. Here the form may also mean that they lead others into prostitution.

decisions.choice: not increase: they will not have children
decisions.reason: "Increase" is literally "break out", used of a family growing in numbers (Genesis 28:14; 30:30). Worship of the gods of the land was meant to bring children and good harvests; the LORD says it will bring neither. Eating without being satisfied is one of the covenant curses (Leviticus 26:26; Micah 6:14).

decisions.choice: they have forsaken heeding the LORD: they have stopped paying heed to him
alternatives: they have forsaken the LORD to devote themselves to prostitution (joining the first word of verse 11)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the LORD they have forsaken to keep". "Forsake" with a verb means to stop doing something, so they have stopped keeping, that is, obeying or paying heed to the LORD. Some take the next word, "prostitution", as the object instead: "they have forsaken the LORD to give themselves to prostitution". The verse division of the Hebrew text puts that word in verse 11.

decisions.choice: prostitute themselves (Literal, Balanced); be unfaithful (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for zanah in Hosea, as in Judges 2:17 and Jeremiah 3:1. Readable puts the picture as unfaithfulness, which is its point (m1).

decisions.choice: not have more children
decisions.reason: Readable says what "not increase" means (m2).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버리고": God speaks of himself by name with no honorific
decisions.reason: Inside God's own speech his name takes no -시- and no 께, as settled for the prophets; the clause is shaped so that the plain particle reads naturally.

decisions.choice: блудить (L, B); изменять (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Russian wording for zanah in Hosea (1:2): "блудить" at Literal and Balanced, "изменять" at Readable, unfaithfulness to the LORD that here includes the sexual rites of the shrines (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Prostitution and wine and new wine take away [the] heart.

en.L: Prostitution and wine and new wine take away the heart.
en.B: Prostitution, wine and new wine take away understanding.
en.R: Unfaithfulness, wine and new wine take away people's good sense.

es.L: La prostitución, el vino y el mosto quitan el corazón.
es.B: La prostitución, el vino y el vino nuevo quitan el entendimiento.
es.R: La infidelidad, el vino y el vino nuevo le quitan a la gente el buen juicio.

fr.L: La prostitution, et le vin, et le vin nouveau ôtent le cœur.
fr.B: La prostitution, le vin et le vin nouveau font perdre le sens.
fr.R: L’infidélité, le vin et le vin nouveau font perdre la raison aux gens.

ko.L: 음행과 포도주와 새 포도주가 마음을 빼앗는다.
ko.B: 음행과 포도주와 새 포도주가 분별력을 빼앗는다.
ko.R: 신실하지 않은 짓과 포도주와 새 포도주가 사람들의 분별력을 빼앗아 간다.

vi.L: Sự đàng điếm, rượu và rượu mới cất mất lòng.
vi.B: Sự lăng loàn, rượu và rượu mới làm mất trí hiểu.
vi.R: Sự bất trung, rượu và rượu mới làm con người mất hết sáng suốt.

sw.L: Ukahaba na divai na divai mpya huondoa moyo.
sw.B: Ukahaba, divai na divai mpya huondoa ufahamu.
sw.R: Kutokuwa mwaminifu, divai na divai mpya huwaondolea watu akili.

pt.L: Prostituição, e vinho, e vinho novo tiram o coração.
pt.B: A prostituição, o vinho e o vinho novo tiram o entendimento.
pt.R: A infidelidade, o vinho e o vinho novo tiram das pessoas o bom senso.

am.L: ዝሙትና የወይን ጠጅ አዲሱም የወይን ጠጅ ልብን ይወስዳሉ።
am.B: ዝሙት፣ የወይን ጠጅና አዲሱ የወይን ጠጅ ማስተዋልን ያሳጣሉ።
am.R: ታማኝ አለመሆን፣ የወይን ጠጅና አዲሱ የወይን ጠጅ የሰዎችን ጤናማ አእምሮ ያሳጣሉ።

hi.L: वेश्यावृत्ति और दाखमधु और नया दाखरस मन को हर लेते हैं।
hi.B: वेश्यावृत्ति, दाखमधु और नया दाखरस समझ को हर लेते हैं।
hi.R: बेवफ़ाई, दाखमधु और नया दाखरस लोगों की अच्छी समझ छीन लेते हैं।

ru.L: Блуд и вино, и молодое вино отнимают сердце.
ru.B: Блуд, вино и молодое вино отнимают разум.
ru.R: Измена, вино и молодое вино лишают людей здравого смысла.

ja.L: 淫行と、ぶどう酒と、新しいぶどう酒は心を奪う。
ja.B: 淫行とぶどう酒と新しいぶどう酒は、分別を奪う。
ja.R: 不誠実な行いと、ぶどう酒と、新しいぶどう酒は、人から正しい判断力を奪ってしまう。

decisions.choice: the heart: the mind and understanding
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the seat of thought and judgment, not chiefly of feeling. To take away the heart is to rob a person of sense (Proverbs 6:32; 7:7). The verse may be a proverb, and verse 12 shows its result: a people who consult pieces of wood.

decisions.choice: prostitution: unfaithfulness to the LORD and the immorality of the shrines
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb of verse 10; see the note there.

decisions.choice: wine and new wine: wine in general and the fresh wine of the year's harvest
decisions.reason: The new wine was a gift of the LORD that Israel credited to Baal (2:10). At the shrines it was drunk freely (verse 18; Amos 2:8).

decisions.choice: Unfaithfulness ... take away people's good sense
decisions.reason: Readable uses its settled wording for the word of verse 10 and says what "heart" means here (m1).

decisions.choice: "cất mất lòng" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "heart", which Vietnamese "lòng" can carry as the seat of thought; Balanced and Readable say "understanding".

source.text: עַמִּי֙ בְּעֵצ֣וֹ יִשְׁאָ֔ל וּמַקְל֖וֹ יַגִּ֣יד ל֑וֹ כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ הִתְעָ֔ה וַיִּזְנ֖וּ מִתַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: My people of their wood inquire, and their staff declares to them; for a spirit of prostitution has led astray, and they have prostituted [themselves] from under their God.

en.L: My people ask their wood, \q and their staff declares to them; \q for a spirit of prostitution has led [them] astray, \q and they have prostituted themselves from under their God.
en.B: My people consult a piece of wood, \q and their stick gives them answers. \q A spirit of prostitution has led them astray, \q and they have prostituted themselves, leaving their God.
en.R: My people ask a wooden idol for advice \q and expect a stick to tell them what to do. \q A desire to be unfaithful has led them astray. \q They have been unfaithful and have left their God.

es.L: Mi pueblo consulta a su madero, \q y su vara le responde; \q porque un espíritu de prostitución [los] ha extraviado, \q y se han prostituido apartándose de su Dios.
es.B: Mi pueblo consulta a un trozo de madera, \q y su palo le da respuestas. \q Un espíritu de prostitución los ha extraviado, \q y se han prostituido, dejando a su Dios.
es.R: Mi pueblo le pide consejo a un ídolo de madera \q y espera que un palo le diga lo que debe hacer. \q El deseo de ser infieles los ha extraviado. \q Han sido infieles y han dejado a su Dios.

fr.L: Mon peuple interroge son bois, \q et son bâton le renseigne ; \q car un esprit de prostitution [les] a égarés, \q et ils se sont prostitués loin de leur Dieu.
fr.B: Mon peuple consulte un morceau de bois, \q et son bâton lui donne des réponses. \q Un esprit de prostitution les a égarés, \q et ils se sont prostitués en abandonnant leur Dieu.
fr.R: Mon peuple demande conseil à une idole en bois \q et attend qu’un bâton lui dise quoi faire. \q Le désir d’être infidèles les a égarés. \q Ils ont été infidèles et ils ont abandonné leur Dieu.

ko.L: 내 백성이 자기 나무에게 묻고, \q 자기 막대기가 그들에게 알려 준다. \q 음행의 영이 [그들을] 미혹하여, \q 그들이 자기 하나님 아래에서 [떠나] 음행했다.
ko.B: 내 백성이 나무 조각에게 묻고, \q 막대기가 그들에게 대답을 준다. \q 음행의 영이 그들을 미혹하여, \q 그들은 자기 하나님을 떠나 음행했다.
ko.R: 내 백성이 나무 우상에게 길을 묻고, \q 막대기가 무엇을 할지 알려 주기를 바란다. \q 신실하지 않으려는 마음이 그들을 그릇된 길로 이끌었다. \q 그들은 신실하지 않게 자기 하나님을 떠났다.

vi.L: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cầu hỏi khúc gỗ của chúng, \q và cây gậy của chúng báo cho chúng; \q vì một tinh thần đàng điếm đã khiến [chúng] lầm lạc, \q và chúng đã làm điếm mà lìa khỏi [quyền] Đức Chúa Trời của chúng.
vi.B: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cầu hỏi một khúc gỗ, \q và cây gậy của chúng trả lời chúng. \q Tinh thần lăng loàn đã khiến chúng lầm lạc, \q và chúng đã làm điếm, lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của mình.
vi.R: Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xin lời khuyên của một tượng gỗ \q và trông chờ một cây gậy chỉ bảo chúng phải làm gì. \q Lòng ham muốn bất trung đã khiến chúng lầm lạc. \q Chúng đã bất trung và lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của mình.

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanataka shauri kwa mti wao, \q na fimbo yao inawaambia; \q kwa maana roho ya ukahaba imewapoteza, \q nao wamefanya ukahaba wakitoka chini ya Mungu wao.
sw.B: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanataka shauri kwa kipande cha mti, \q na fimbo yao inawapa majibu. \q Roho ya ukahaba imewapotosha, \q nao wamefanya ukahaba, wakamwacha Mungu wao.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanaomba shauri kwa sanamu ya mti \q na kutarajia fimbo iwaambie la kufanya. \q Tamaa ya kutokuwa waaminifu imewapotosha. \q Hawajakuwa waaminifu, nao wamemwacha Mungu wao.

pt.L: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo consulta a sua madeira, \q e o seu bordão lhe responde; \q porque um espírito de prostituição [os] desviou, \q e eles se prostituíram, [saindo] de debaixo do seu Deus.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo consulta um pedaço de pau, \q e a sua vara lhe dá respostas. \q Um espírito de prostituição os desviou, \q e eles se prostituíram, abandonando o seu Deus.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo pede conselhos a um ídolo de madeira \q e espera que uma vara lhe diga o que fazer. \q Um desejo de ser infiel os desviou. \q Eles foram infiéis e abandonaram o seu Deus.

am.L: ሕዝቤ እንጨታቸውን ይጠይቃሉ፤ \q በትራቸውም ይነግራቸዋል፤ \q የዝሙት መንፈስ አስቷቸዋልና፤ \q ከአምላካቸውም በታች [ወጥተው] ዝሙት ፈጸሙ።
am.B: ሕዝቤ የእንጨት ቁራጭ ይጠይቃሉ፤ \q በትራቸውም መልስ ይሰጣቸዋል። \q የዝሙት መንፈስ አስቷቸዋል፤ \q አምላካቸውን ትተው ዝሙት ፈጽመዋል።
am.R: ሕዝቤ ከእንጨት የተሠራ ጣዖትን ምክር ይጠይቃሉ፤ \q በትርም ምን ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው እንዲነግራቸው ይጠብቃሉ። \q ታማኝ ያለመሆን ምኞት አስቷቸዋል። \q ታማኝ አልሆኑም፤ አምላካቸውንም ትተዋል።

hi.L: मेरी प्रजा अपनी लकड़ी से पूछती है, \q और उनकी छड़ी उन्हें बताती है; \q क्योंकि वेश्यावृत्ति की आत्मा ने [उन्हें] भटका दिया है, \q और वे अपने परमेश्वर के अधीन से हटकर वेश्यावृत्ति करते हैं।
hi.B: मेरी प्रजा लकड़ी के एक टुकड़े से सलाह लेती है, \q और उनकी छड़ी उन्हें उत्तर देती है। \q वेश्यावृत्ति की आत्मा ने उन्हें भटका दिया है, \q और वे अपने परमेश्वर को छोड़कर वेश्यावृत्ति करते हैं।
hi.R: मेरे लोग लकड़ी की मूर्ति से सलाह माँगते हैं \q और आशा करते हैं कि एक छड़ी उन्हें बताएगी कि क्या करें। \q बेवफ़ाई की लालसा ने उन्हें भटका दिया है। \q वे बेवफ़ा हो गए हैं और अपने परमेश्वर को छोड़ दिया है।

ru.L: Мой народ вопрошает своё дерево, \q и его посох возвещает ему; \q потому что дух блуда ввёл [их] в заблуждение, \q и они блудят, [уходя] из-под [власти] своего Бога.
ru.B: Мой народ спрашивает совета у куска дерева, \q и палка даёт ему ответы. \q Дух блуда сбил их с пути, \q и они блудят, оставив своего Бога.
ru.R: Мой народ просит совета у деревянного идола \q и ждёт, что палка скажет ему, что делать. \q Желание изменять сбило их с пути. \q Они изменили и оставили своего Бога.

ja.L: わたしの民は自分の木に伺いを立て、 \q その杖が彼らに告げる。 \q 淫行の霊が[彼らを]迷わせ、 \q 彼らは自分の神の下から離れて淫行をした。
ja.B: わたしの民は木切れに伺いを立て、 \q その杖が彼らに答えを告げる。 \q 淫行の霊が彼らを迷わせ、 \q 彼らは自分の神を離れて淫行にふけった。
ja.R: わたしの民は、木の偶像に助言を求め、 \q 棒切れが何をすべきかを教えてくれると思っている。 \q ほかの神々を慕う思いが、彼らを迷わせた。 \q 彼らは神を裏切り、自分の神から離れてしまった。

decisions.choice: their wood ... their staff: a wooden idol or sacred pole, and a stick used to seek omens
alternatives: their wood: a tree at a shrine
decisions.reason: "Wood" is used with scorn for idols made of wood (Jeremiah 2:27; 10:8; Habakkuk 2:19). The "staff" or stick was probably used for divination, perhaps by throwing it down and reading how it fell. Both were forbidden ways of seeking guidance (Deuteronomy 18:10-14). The LORD's people ask a piece of wood instead of asking him.

decisions.choice: a spirit of prostitution: an urge to be unfaithful that has taken hold of them
decisions.reason: "Spirit" here is an inner drive or disposition that controls a person (compare "a spirit of jealousy", Numbers 5:14). The same phrase comes in 5:4. The people are no longer free to turn back; unfaithfulness drives them.

decisions.choice: prostituted themselves from under their God: left their God as an unfaithful wife leaves her husband
decisions.reason: A wife was said to be "under" her husband, under his authority and protection (Numbers 5:19-20, 29). To go astray "from under" one's God is to leave him as an unfaithful wife leaves her husband.

decisions.choice: a piece of wood ... their stick (Balanced); a wooden idol ... a stick to tell them what to do (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the scornful plainness of "wood"; Readable says what it was (m1). Readable also says what the stick was used for.

decisions.choice: A desire to be unfaithful ... have been unfaithful
decisions.reason: Readable uses its settled wording for zanah (4:10) and says "desire" for "spirit" here, because it means an inner urge (m2).

decisions.choice: "roho ya ukahaba" (a spirit of prostitution), lowercase
decisions.reason: A human urge that has taken hold of the people (m2), not God's Spirit, so "roho" is lowercase (term sheet).

decisions.choice: ruach zenunim "淫行の霊" (L, B), "ほかの神々を慕う思い" (R, for the English Readable "a desire to be unfaithful", m2); ruach is "霊" as Isaiah 4:4, not the Holy Spirit. sha'al be "伺いを立てる" (L, B), "助言を求める" (R), as Kings and Isaiah 8:19.
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions for ruach; Readable names what the unfaithfulness is (m1, m3).

source.text: עַל־רָאשֵׁ֨י הֶהָרִ֜ים יְזַבֵּ֗חוּ וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת֙ יְקַטֵּ֔רוּ תַּ֣חַת אַלּ֧וֹן וְלִבְנֶ֛ה וְאֵלָ֖ה כִּ֣י ט֣וֹב צִלָּ֑הּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן תִּזְנֶ֨ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְכַלּוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תְּנָאַֽפְנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] tops of the mountains they sacrifice, and on the hills they burn offerings, under oak and poplar and terebinth, for good [is] its shade; therefore prostitute [themselves] your daughters, and your brides commit adultery.

en.L: On the tops of the mountains they sacrifice, and on the hills they burn offerings, \q under oak and poplar and terebinth, because its shade [is] good. \q Therefore your daughters prostitute themselves, \q and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
en.B: They offer sacrifices on the tops of the mountains and burn offerings on the hills, \q under oak, poplar and terebinth, since their shade is good. \q That is why your daughters prostitute themselves \q and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
en.R: They offer sacrifices on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, \q under oaks, poplars and terebinth trees, where the shade is pleasant. \q That is why your daughters act like prostitutes \q and your sons' wives commit adultery.

es.L: Sobre las cumbres de los montes sacrifican, y sobre las colinas queman ofrendas, \q debajo del roble, del álamo y del terebinto, porque su sombra [es] buena. \q Por eso se prostituyen {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}}, \q y {{plural_you:sus nueras|vuestras nueras}} cometen adulterio.
es.B: Ofrecen sacrificios en las cumbres de los montes y queman ofrendas en las colinas, \q bajo robles, álamos y terebintos, porque su sombra es agradable. \q Por eso {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} se prostituyen \q y {{plural_you:sus nueras|vuestras nueras}} cometen adulterio.
es.R: Ofrecen sacrificios en las cumbres de los montes y queman ofrendas en las colinas, \q bajo los robles, los álamos y los terebintos, donde la sombra es agradable. \q Por eso {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} se comportan como prostitutas \q y las esposas de {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} cometen adulterio.

fr.L: Sur les sommets des montagnes ils sacrifient, et sur les collines ils brûlent des offrandes, \q sous le chêne, le peuplier et le térébinthe, car son ombre [est] bonne. \q C’est pourquoi vos filles se prostituent, \q et vos belles-filles commettent l’adultère.
fr.B: Ils offrent des sacrifices au sommet des montagnes et brûlent des offrandes sur les collines, \q sous le chêne, le peuplier et le térébinthe, car leur ombre est bonne. \q Voilà pourquoi vos filles se prostituent \q et vos belles-filles commettent l’adultère.
fr.R: Ils offrent des sacrifices au sommet des montagnes et brûlent des offrandes sur les collines, \q sous les chênes, les peupliers et les térébinthes, où l’ombre est agréable. \q C’est pour cela que vos filles se conduisent comme des prostituées \q et que les femmes de vos fils commettent l’adultère.

ko.L: 그들이 산꼭대기에서 제사를 드리고 언덕 위에서 분향한다. \q 참나무와 버드나무와 상수리나무 아래에서, 그 그늘이 좋기 때문이다. \q 그러므로 너희 딸들이 음행하고, \q 너희 며느리들이 간음한다.
ko.B: 그들은 산꼭대기에서 제사를 드리고, 언덕 위에서 향을 피운다. \q 참나무와 버드나무와 상수리나무 아래에서 그렇게 한다. 그 그늘이 좋기 때문이다. \q 그래서 너희 딸들이 음행하고, \q 너희 며느리들이 간음한다.
ko.R: 그들은 산꼭대기에서 제사를 드리고, 언덕 위에서 향을 피운다. \q 그늘이 좋은 참나무와 버드나무와 상수리나무 아래에서 그렇게 한다. \q 그러니 너희 딸들이 창녀처럼 몸을 팔고, \q 너희 며느리들이 간음한다.

vi.L: Trên các đỉnh núi chúng dâng sinh tế, và trên các đồi chúng đốt [của lễ], \q dưới cây sồi, cây bạch dương và cây thông nhựa, vì bóng của nó tốt. \q Vì vậy con gái các ngươi làm điếm, \q và con dâu các ngươi ngoại tình.
vi.B: Chúng dâng sinh tế trên các đỉnh núi và đốt của lễ trên các đồi, \q dưới cây sồi, cây bạch dương và cây thông nhựa, vì bóng mát của chúng dễ chịu. \q Vì thế con gái các ngươi làm điếm \q và con dâu các ngươi phạm tội ngoại tình.
vi.R: Chúng dâng sinh tế trên các đỉnh núi và đốt của lễ trên các ngọn đồi, \q dưới những cây sồi, cây bạch dương và cây thông nhựa, nơi có bóng mát dễ chịu. \q Vì thế con gái các ngươi cư xử như gái mại dâm, \q và vợ của con trai các ngươi ngoại tình.

sw.L: Juu ya vilele vya milima wanatoa dhabihu, na juu ya vilima wanafukiza [sadaka], \q chini ya mwaloni na mpopla na mti mkubwa, kwa sababu kivuli chake [ni] kizuri. \q Kwa hiyo binti zenu wanafanya ukahaba, \q na wakwe zenu wanazini.
sw.B: Wanatoa dhabihu juu ya vilele vya milima na kufukiza sadaka juu ya vilima, \q chini ya mwaloni, mpopla na mti mkubwa, kwa kuwa kivuli chake ni kizuri. \q Ndiyo sababu binti zenu wanafanya ukahaba \q na wake wa wana wenu wanazini.
sw.R: Wanatoa dhabihu juu ya vilele vya milima na kufukiza sadaka juu ya vilima, \q chini ya mialoni, mipopla na miti mikubwa, ambako kuna kivuli kizuri. \q Ndiyo sababu binti zenu wanatenda kama makahaba \q na wake wa wana wenu wanazini.

pt.L: Sobre os cumes dos montes sacrificam, e sobre as colinas queimam ofertas, \q debaixo do carvalho, e do álamo, e do terebinto, porque a sua sombra [é] boa. \q Por isso as filhas de vocês se prostituem, \q e as noras de vocês cometem adultério.

pt.R: Eles oferecem sacrifícios no alto dos montes e queimam ofertas nas colinas, \q debaixo de carvalhos, álamos e terebintos, onde a sombra é agradável. \q É por isso que as filhas de vocês agem como prostitutas \q e as esposas dos filhos de vocês cometem adultério.

am.L: በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ይሠዋሉ፤ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ \q ጥላው መልካም ስለ ሆነ ከባሉጥ፣ ከልብንና ከኤላ ዛፍ በታች። \q ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ \q ምራቶቻችሁም ያመነዝራሉ።
am.B: በተራሮች ራስ ላይ መሥዋዕት ያቀርባሉ፤ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ \q ጥላቸው መልካም ስለ ሆነ ከባሉጥ፣ ከልብንና ከኤላ ዛፍ ሥር ያደርጉታል። \q ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ \q ምራቶቻችሁም ያመነዝራሉ።
am.R: በተራሮች ጫፍ ላይ መሥዋዕት ያቀርባሉ፤ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ \q ጥላቸው ደስ የሚያሰኝ በሆነ በባሉጥ፣ በልብንና በኤላ ዛፎች ሥር። \q ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ እንደ ዝሙት አዳሪዎች ይሆናሉ፤ \q የወንዶች ልጆቻችሁ ሚስቶችም ያመነዝራሉ።

hi.L: पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर वे बलि चढ़ाते हैं, और पहाड़ियों पर धूप जलाते हैं, \q बांज और चिनार और बलूत के नीचे, क्योंकि उसकी छाया अच्छी [है]। \q इसलिए तुम्हारी बेटियाँ वेश्यावृत्ति करती हैं, \q और तुम्हारी बहुएँ व्यभिचार करती हैं।
hi.B: वे पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर बलि चढ़ाते हैं और पहाड़ियों पर धूप जलाते हैं, \q बांज, चिनार और बलूत के नीचे, क्योंकि उनकी छाया अच्छी है। \q इसी कारण तुम्हारी बेटियाँ वेश्यावृत्ति करती हैं \q और तुम्हारी बहुएँ व्यभिचार करती हैं।
hi.R: वे पहाड़ों की चोटियों पर बलि चढ़ाते हैं और पहाड़ियों पर धूप जलाते हैं, \q बांज, चिनार और बलूत के पेड़ों के नीचे, जहाँ छाया सुहावनी होती है। \q इसी कारण तुम्हारी बेटियाँ वेश्याओं जैसा काम करती हैं \q और तुम्हारे बेटों की पत्नियाँ व्यभिचार करती हैं।

ru.L: На вершинах гор они приносят жертвы, и на холмах воскуряют, \q под дубом, и тополем, и теребинтом, потому что хороша их тень. \q Поэтому блудят ваши дочери, \q и ваши невестки прелюбодействуют.
ru.B: На вершинах гор они приносят жертвы и на холмах воскуряют, \q под дубом, тополем и теребинтом, потому что тень от них хороша. \q Вот почему ваши дочери блудят, \q а ваши невестки изменяют мужьям.
ru.R: На вершинах гор они приносят жертвы и на холмах сжигают приношения, \q под дубами, тополями и теребинтами, где приятная тень. \q Вот почему ваши дочери ведут себя как блудницы, \q а жёны ваших сыновей нарушают супружескую верность.

ja.L: 山々の頂で彼らはいけにえをささげ、丘の上で供え物を焼いて煙を立ち上らせる。 \q 樫とポプラとテレビンの木の下で。その陰が心地よいからだ。 \q それゆえ、あなたがたの娘たちは淫行をし、 \q あなたがたの嫁たちは姦淫をする。
ja.B: 彼らは山々の頂でいけにえをささげ、丘の上で供え物を焼いてささげる。 \q 樫やポプラやテレビンの木の下で。その木陰が心地よいからだ。 \q それで、あなたがたの娘たちは淫行をし、 \q あなたがたの嫁たちは姦淫をする。
ja.R: 彼らは山の頂上でいけにえをささげ、丘の上で供え物を焼く。 \q 樫やポプラやテレビンの木の下で。その木陰が心地よいからだ。 \q だから、あなたたちの娘たちは、体を売る女のようなことをし、 \q 息子の妻たちは姦淫をする。

decisions.choice: mountaintops, hills and shady trees: the open-air shrines of the gods of the land
decisions.reason: Worship of other gods was carried out at shrines on high places and under leafy trees (Deuteronomy 12:2; 1 Kings 14:23; Jeremiah 2:20; 3:6). The law commanded that such places be destroyed. Israel offered sacrifices there, often in the LORD's name but in the ways of Baal worship.

decisions.choice: burn offerings: make offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke on an altar. It is used both for burning the fat of sacrifices and for burning incense (2:15; 11:2).

decisions.choice: oak, poplar and terebinth: large shade trees
decisions.reason: The exact kinds of tree are not certain. The second word means "white one" and may be the white poplar or the storax tree (Genesis 30:37). All three gave deep shade, which the worshipers sought out.

decisions.choice: your daughters prostitute themselves, your daughters-in-law commit adultery: the young women of the families take part in the sexual rites of the shrines
decisions.reason: Here zanah has its literal sense, set beside adultery. "Your" is plural: the men of Israel. The word for daughters-in-law also means "brides", young married women. Because the men worship at the shrines, the women of their households follow them there.

decisions.choice: act like prostitutes
decisions.reason: Readable usually says "be unfaithful" for zanah (4:10), but here the women's own sexual conduct is meant (m4), and "unfaithful" would not fit unmarried daughters. Readable says "act like prostitutes" so the meaning is not blurred.

decisions.choice: your sons' wives
decisions.reason: Readable says what "daughters-in-law" are, in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "[[sus hijas|vuestras hijas]]", "[[sus nueras|vuestras nueras]]"
decisions.reason: Here the "your" is plural, the men of Israel, so it takes the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "se comportan como prostitutas"
decisions.reason: Literal prostitution at the shrines is said plainly, as the terms note for these books sets; "ser infiel" is kept for Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

decisions.choice: "se conduisent comme des prostituées" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the daughters take part in the shrines' sexual rites, so Readable says so plainly, as the English Readable does, instead of the "être infidèle" used for Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

decisions.choice: "창녀처럼 몸을 팔고" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal prostitution is said plainly at Readable, as the English "act like prostitutes"; "신실하지 않다" is kept for Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

decisions.choice: "làm điếm" (L, B); "cư xử như gái mại dâm" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the daughters' prostitution is literal, so Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does, keeping "bất trung" for Israel's unfaithfulness to God; "gái mại dâm" is the terms note's word for literal prostitution.

decisions.choice: "mwaloni" (oak), "mpopla" (poplar), "mti mkubwa" (terebinth)
decisions.reason: The names the published Swahili uses: "mpopla" as Genesis 30:37, and "mti mkubwa" for the terebinth where it stands beside the oak, as Isaiah 6:13.

decisions.choice: "wakwe zenu" (L); "wake wa wana wenu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the one Hebrew word with "wakwe" (in-laws, here the brides of the house); Balanced and Readable say plainly "your sons' wives".

decisions.choice: as filhas de vocês ... se prostituem (L, B), agem como prostitutas (R)
decisions.reason: Here zanah is the young women's own conduct (m4), so Readable says "agem como prostitutas", as the English Readable does (r-en-1), and not "ser infiel" as elsewhere. The "your" is plural, the men of Israel, so "de vocês".

decisions.choice: "ባሉጥ" (oak), "ልብን" (poplar), "ኤላ ዛፍ" (terebinth)
decisions.reason: "ባሉጥ" and "ልብን" are the words used for these trees in the Amharic Genesis (35:8; 30:37). Since "ባሉጥ" stands for the oak here, the terebinth (ʾelah) is named "ኤላ ዛፍ" after its Hebrew name, so the three trees stay distinct; a reviewer may prefer a local tree name.

decisions.choice: वेश्याओं जैसा काम करती हैं (R)
decisions.reason: Readable usually says बेवफ़ाई for zanah, but here the young women's own sexual conduct at the shrines is meant (m4), so it says so plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ведут себя как блудницы (R)
decisions.reason: Readable usually says "изменять" for zanah (4:10), but here the young women's own sexual conduct at the shrines is meant (m4), so Readable says "ведут себя как блудницы", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: 'allon "樫", livneh "ポプラ", 'elah "テレビンの木" at every level (m3), kept apart as Isaiah 1:29 and 2:13 keep 'elim and 'allonim apart; kallot "嫁たち" (L, B), "息子の妻たち" (R).
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions for the trees of the shrines.

source.text: לֹֽא־אֶפְק֨וֹד עַל־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם כִּ֣י תִזְנֶ֗ינָה וְעַל־כַּלּֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ כִּ֣י תְנָאַ֔פְנָה כִּי־הֵם֙ עִם־הַזֹּנ֣וֹת יְפָרֵ֔דוּ וְעִם־הַקְּדֵשׁ֖וֹת יְזַבֵּ֑חוּ וְעָ֥ם לֹֽא־יָבִ֖ין יִלָּבֵֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: Not I will visit on your daughters when they prostitute [themselves], and on your brides when they commit adultery; for they themselves with the prostitutes go aside, and with the cult prostitutes sacrifice; and a people [that] not understands will be thrown down.

en.L: I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, or your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, \q for they themselves go aside with prostitutes \q and sacrifice with cult prostitutes; \q and a people [that] does not understand will come to ruin.
en.B: I will not punish your daughters for prostituting themselves, nor your daughters-in-law for committing adultery, \q since the men themselves slip away with prostitutes \q and sacrifice alongside shrine prostitutes. \q A people without understanding will come to ruin.
en.R: But I will not punish your daughters for acting like prostitutes, or your sons' wives for their adultery, \q because the men themselves go off with prostitutes \q and offer sacrifices with women who serve as prostitutes at the shrines. \q A people who do not understand will be ruined.

es.L: No pediré cuentas a {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} cuando se prostituyan, ni a {{plural_you:sus nueras|vuestras nueras}} cuando cometan adulterio, \q porque ellos mismos se apartan con las prostitutas \q y sacrifican con las prostitutas del culto; \q y el pueblo [que] no entiende se arruinará.
es.B: No castigaré a {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} por prostituirse, ni a {{plural_you:sus nueras|vuestras nueras}} por cometer adulterio, \q porque los hombres mismos se van a escondidas con prostitutas \q y ofrecen sacrificios junto a las prostitutas de los santuarios. \q Un pueblo sin entendimiento se arruinará.
es.R: Pero no castigaré a {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} por comportarse como prostitutas, ni a las esposas de {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} por su adulterio, \q porque los hombres mismos se van con prostitutas \q y ofrecen sacrificios con mujeres que sirven como prostitutas en los santuarios. \q Un pueblo que no entiende se arruinará.

fr.L: Je ne punirai pas vos filles quand elles se prostituent, ni vos belles-filles quand elles commettent l’adultère, \q car eux-mêmes s’écartent avec les prostituées \q et sacrifient avec les prostituées sacrées ; \q et un peuple [qui] ne comprend pas court à sa perte.
fr.B: Je ne punirai pas vos filles parce qu’elles se prostituent, ni vos belles-filles parce qu’elles commettent l’adultère, \q puisque les hommes eux-mêmes s’en vont à l’écart avec des prostituées \q et sacrifient avec les prostituées des sanctuaires. \q Un peuple sans intelligence court à sa perte.
fr.R: Mais je ne punirai pas vos filles parce qu’elles se conduisent comme des prostituées, ni les femmes de vos fils pour leur adultère, \q parce que les hommes eux-mêmes partent avec des prostituées \q et offrent des sacrifices avec des femmes qui servent de prostituées dans les sanctuaires. \q Un peuple qui ne comprend pas sera détruit.

ko.L: 너희 딸들이 음행해도 내가 벌하지 않고, 너희 며느리들이 간음해도 [벌하지] 않겠다. \q [남자들] 자신이 창녀들과 함께 [따로] 나가고, \q 신전 창녀들과 함께 제사를 드리기 때문이다. \q 깨닫지 못하는 백성은 망할 것이다.
ko.B: 너희 딸들이 음행하여도 내가 벌하지 않고, 너희 며느리들이 간음하여도 벌하지 않겠다. \q 남자들 자신이 창녀들과 함께 몰래 빠져나가고, \q 신전 창녀들과 함께 제사를 드리기 때문이다. \q 깨닫지 못하는 백성은 망하고 말 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 너희 딸들이 몸을 팔아도, 너희 며느리들이 간음해도 그들을 벌하지 않겠다. \q 남자들 자신이 창녀들과 함께 놀아나고, \q 신전에서 몸을 파는 여자들과 함께 제사를 드리기 때문이다. \q 깨닫지 못하는 백성은 망할 것이다.

vi.L: Ta sẽ không thăm phạt con gái các ngươi khi chúng làm điếm, hay con dâu các ngươi khi chúng ngoại tình, \q vì chính chúng đi riêng với gái điếm \q và dâng sinh tế với các gái điếm của đền miếu; \q và một dân không hiểu biết sẽ bị lật đổ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ không trừng phạt con gái các ngươi vì chúng làm điếm, cũng không trừng phạt con dâu các ngươi vì chúng ngoại tình, \q vì chính những người đàn ông lén đi với gái điếm \q và dâng sinh tế cùng với gái mại dâm nơi đền miếu. \q Một dân không hiểu biết sẽ bị diệt vong.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không trừng phạt con gái các ngươi vì cư xử như gái mại dâm, hay vợ của con trai các ngươi vì tội ngoại tình, \q vì chính những người đàn ông cũng đi với gái mại dâm \q và dâng sinh tế với những phụ nữ làm mại dâm tại các đền miếu. \q Một dân không hiểu biết sẽ bị tiêu diệt.

sw.L: Sitawaadhibu binti zenu wanapofanya ukahaba, wala wakwe zenu wanapozini, \q kwa maana wao wenyewe wanakwenda kando pamoja na makahaba \q na kutoa dhabihu pamoja na makahaba wa mahali pa ibada; \q na watu wasiofahamu wataangamia.
sw.B: Sitawaadhibu binti zenu kwa kufanya ukahaba, wala wake wa wana wenu kwa kuzini, \q kwa kuwa wanaume wenyewe wanajitenga pamoja na makahaba \q na kutoa dhabihu pamoja na makahaba wa mahali pa ibada. \q Watu wasio na ufahamu wataangamia.
sw.R: Lakini sitawaadhibu binti zenu kwa kutenda kama makahaba, wala wake wa wana wenu kwa uzinzi wao, \q kwa sababu wanaume wenyewe wanakwenda na makahaba \q na kutoa dhabihu pamoja na wanawake wanaofanya ukahaba mahali pa ibada. \q Watu wasiofahamu wataangamizwa.

pt.L: Não castigarei as filhas de vocês quando se prostituírem, nem as noras de vocês quando cometerem adultério, \q porque eles mesmos se afastam com as prostitutas \q e sacrificam com as prostitutas cultuais; \q e um povo [que] não entende será arruinado.
pt.B: Não castigarei as filhas de vocês por se prostituírem, nem as noras de vocês por cometerem adultério, \q pois os próprios homens se retiram com prostitutas \q e oferecem sacrifícios junto com prostitutas de santuário. \q Um povo sem entendimento será arruinado.
pt.R: Mas não vou castigar as filhas de vocês por agirem como prostitutas, nem as esposas dos filhos de vocês pelo adultério delas, \q porque os próprios homens vão atrás de prostitutas \q e oferecem sacrifícios com mulheres que servem como prostitutas nos santuários. \q Um povo que não entende vai ser arruinado.

am.L: ዝሙት ሲፈጽሙ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን፣ ሲያመነዝሩም ምራቶቻችሁን አልቀጣም፤ \q እነርሱ ራሳቸው ከዝሙት አዳሪዎች ጋር ገለል ይላሉና፤ \q ከቤተ ጣዖት ዝሙት አዳሪዎችም ጋር ይሠዋሉና፤ \q የማያስተውልም ሕዝብ ይወድቃል።
am.B: ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ዝሙት ስለ ፈጸሙ፣ ምራቶቻችሁንም ስላመነዘሩ አልቀጣም፤ \q ወንዶቹ ራሳቸው ከዝሙት አዳሪዎች ጋር ገለል ይላሉና፤ \q ከቤተ ጣዖት ዝሙት አዳሪዎችም ጋር መሥዋዕት ያቀርባሉና። \q የማያስተውል ሕዝብ ይጠፋል።
am.R: ነገር ግን ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን እንደ ዝሙት አዳሪዎች ስለ ሆኑ፣ የወንዶች ልጆቻችሁንም ሚስቶች ስላመነዘሩ አልቀጣም፤ \q ወንዶቹ ራሳቸው ከዝሙት አዳሪዎች ጋር ይሄዳሉና፤ \q በቤተ ጣዖት ዝሙት ከሚያዳሩ ሴቶች ጋርም መሥዋዕት ያቀርባሉና። \q የማያስተውል ሕዝብ ይጠፋል።

hi.L: जब तुम्हारी बेटियाँ वेश्यावृत्ति करती हैं, तो मैं उन्हें दंड न दूँगा, और न तुम्हारी बहुओं को जब वे व्यभिचार करती हैं, \q क्योंकि वे आप ही वेश्याओं के साथ अलग जाते हैं \q और देवदासियों के साथ बलि चढ़ाते हैं; \q और जो प्रजा नहीं समझती वह नाश हो जाएगी।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हारी बेटियों को वेश्यावृत्ति के लिए दंड न दूँगा, और न तुम्हारी बहुओं को व्यभिचार के लिए, \q क्योंकि पुरुष आप ही वेश्याओं के साथ एकांत में जाते हैं \q और पूजा-स्थल की वेश्याओं के साथ बलि चढ़ाते हैं। \q समझ से रहित प्रजा नाश हो जाएगी।
hi.R: पर मैं तुम्हारी बेटियों को वेश्याओं जैसे काम के लिए, या तुम्हारे बेटों की पत्नियों को उनके व्यभिचार के लिए दंड नहीं दूँगा, \q क्योंकि पुरुष ख़ुद वेश्याओं के पास जाते हैं \q और उन स्त्रियों के साथ बलि चढ़ाते हैं जो पूजा-स्थलों पर वेश्या का काम करती हैं। \q जो लोग नहीं समझते, वे नाश हो जाएँगे।

ru.L: Не взыщу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с ваших дочерей, когда они блудят, и с ваших невесток, когда они прелюбодействуют, \q потому что сами они уединяются с блудницами \q и приносят жертвы с храмовыми блудницами; \q и народ, не разумеющий, погибнет.
ru.B: Я не накажу ваших дочерей за то, что они блудят, и ваших невесток за то, что они изменяют мужьям, \q потому что сами мужчины уходят с блудницами \q и приносят жертвы вместе с храмовыми блудницами. \q Народ, лишённый разума, погибнет.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не накажу ваших дочерей за то, что они ведут себя как блудницы, и жён ваших сыновей за измену, \q потому что сами мужчины ходят к блудницам \q и приносят жертвы с женщинами, которые занимаются блудом при святилищах. \q Народ, который не понимает, будет разорён.

ja.L: わたしは、あなたがたの娘たちが淫行をしても、あなたがたの嫁たちが姦淫をしても、[彼女たちを]罰しない。 \q 彼ら自身が遊女たちと共に離れて行き、 \q 聖なる女たちと共にいけにえをささげているからだ。 \q 悟らない民は打ち倒される。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたがたの娘たちが淫行をしても、嫁たちが姦淫をしても、彼女たちを罰しない。 \q 男たち自身が遊女たちとこっそり出かけ、 \q 神殿娼婦たちと共にいけにえをささげているからだ。 \q 悟りのない民は滅びに至る。
ja.R: しかし、わたしは、あなたたちの娘たちが体を売る女のようなことをしても、息子の妻たちが姦淫をしても、彼女たちを罰しない。 \q 男たち自身が、体を売る女たちのところへ出かけて行き、 \q 神殿で体を売る女たちと一緒にいけにえをささげているからだ。 \q 悟ることのない民は滅びる。

decisions.choice: I will not punish your daughters ...: the women will not bear the blame alone
alternatives: a threat: I will no longer punish them, that is, I will leave them to their sin (as Romans 1:24)
decisions.reason: The men who took part in the same rites had no right to condemn the women for following them. The LORD will not single out the women while the men go free; the guilt lies first with the men, and the whole people will come to ruin. The saying does not excuse the women but turns the charge on the men.

decisions.choice: they themselves: the men
decisions.reason: The pronoun is masculine and emphatic, set against the daughters and daughters-in-law.

decisions.choice: cult prostitutes: women connected with the shrines, probably for sexual rites
decisions.reason: The word means "consecrated women" and stands beside the ordinary word for prostitutes, as in Genesis 38:21-22 and Deuteronomy 23:18. How these women served at the shrines is not certain; Hosea sets them in the setting of sacrifice.

decisions.choice: will come to ruin: will be thrown down
decisions.reason: The verb is rare; in Proverbs 10:8, 10 it is used of a fool who comes to ruin. A people without understanding (verse 11) will fall.

decisions.choice: cult prostitutes (Literal); shrine prostitutes (Balanced); women who serve as prostitutes at the shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 23:18 and 1 Kings 14:24.

decisions.choice: the men
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "they" are (m2).

decisions.choice: "prostitutas del culto" (L); "prostitutas de los santuarios" (B); "mujeres que sirven como prostitutas en los santuarios" (R)
decisions.reason: Women tied to the shrines, probably for sexual rites; each level follows the English, saying it plainly.

decisions.choice: "신전 창녀들" (L, B); "신전에서 몸을 파는 여자들" (R)
decisions.reason: *Qedeshot*, women attached to the shrines; the shared meaning decision says the sense is probably sexual rites, and Korean names them plainly.

decisions.choice: "makahaba wa mahali pa ibada" (cult prostitutes)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no single word for the *qedeshah*; "of the place of worship" ties them to the shrines (m3) at Literal and Balanced, and Readable spells it out.

decisions.choice: "gái điếm của đền miếu" (L); "gái mại dâm nơi đền miếu" (B); "những phụ nữ làm mại dâm tại các đền miếu" (R)
decisions.reason: Plain words for the shrine women, matching the English at each level; "kỹ nữ" suggests an entertainer.

decisions.choice: prostitutas cultuais (L); prostitutas de santuário (B); mulheres que servem como prostitutas nos santuários (R)
decisions.reason: The wording Deuteronomy 23:18 has in Portuguese at each level, as the English follows it (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "የቤተ ጣዖት ዝሙት አዳሪዎች" (L, B) for the cult prostitutes (qedeshot); R "በቤተ ጣዖት ዝሙት ከሚያዳሩ ሴቶች"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 14:24 on main words the male form, so the link to the shrines is kept and they are not confused with the ordinary prostitutes (zonot) of the line before.

decisions.choice: देवदासियों (L); पूजा-स्थल की वेश्याओं (B); उन स्त्रियों ... जो पूजा-स्थलों पर वेश्या का काम करती हैं (R)
decisions.reason: The qedeshot were women attached to the shrines, probably for sexual rites (m3). The levels keep the wording of Deuteronomy 23:18: Literal देवदासी, Balanced and Readable a description.

decisions.choice: храмовые блудницы (L, B); женщины, которые занимаются блудом при святилищах (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 14:24 and 15:12 have the male word in this translation ("храмовые блудники"; "мужчины, которые занимались блудом при святилищах" at Readable).

decisions.choice: zonot "遊女たち" (L, B), "体を売る女たち" (R), as Isaiah 1:21; qedeshot "聖なる女たち" (L), "神殿娼婦たち" (B), "神殿で体を売る女たち" (R), as Genesis 38:21, kept apart from zonah (m3).
decisions.reason: The forms already settled; the shrine women are named plainly without coarse words.

records.literal_gloss: If prostituting [are] you, Israel, [let] not become guilty Judah; and do not go [to] the Gilgal, and do not go up [to] Beth-aven, and do not swear, [As] lives Yahweh.

en.L: Though you prostitute yourself, Israel, \q let not Judah become guilty; \q and do not go to Gilgal, and do not go up to Beth-aven, \q and do not swear, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives."
en.B: Though you, Israel, prostitute yourself, \q do not let Judah become guilty. \q Stay away from Gilgal; do not go up to Beth-aven; \q and do not take the oath, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives."
en.R: Israel, even if you are unfaithful, \q Judah must not become guilty too. \q Do not go to worship at Gilgal or go up to Beth-aven. \q Do not make promises there by saying, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives."

es.L: Aunque tú te prostituyas, Israel, \q que no se haga culpable Judá; \q y no {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} a Guilgal, ni {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} a Bet-avén, \q ni {{plural_you:juren|juréis}}: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Aunque tú, Israel, te prostituyas, \q que Judá no se haga culpable. \q No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} a Guilgal; no {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} a Bet-avén; \q no {{plural_you:juren|juréis}} diciendo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Israel, aunque tú seas infiel, \q Judá no debe hacerse culpable también. \q No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} a adorar a Guilgal ni {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} a Bet-avén. \q No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} promesas allí diciendo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Si toi, tu te prostitues, Israël, \q que Juda ne se rende pas coupable ; \q et n’allez pas à Guilgal, et ne montez pas à Beth-Aven, \q et ne jurez pas : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant. »
fr.B: Si toi, Israël, tu te prostitues, \q que Juda ne se rende pas coupable. \q N’allez pas à Guilgal ; ne montez pas à Beth-Aven ; \q et ne prêtez pas serment en disant : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant. »
fr.R: Israël, même si tu es infidèle, \q Juda ne doit pas devenir coupable lui aussi. \q N’allez pas adorer à Guilgal et ne montez pas à Beth-Aven. \q N’y faites pas de promesses en disant : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant. »

ko.L: 이스라엘아, 너는 음행하여도 \q 유다는 죄를 짓지 않게 하여라. \q 길갈로 가지 말고, 벧아웬으로 올라가지 말며, \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다" 하고 맹세하지 마라.
ko.B: 이스라엘아, 너는 음행하여도 \q 유다는 죄를 짓지 않게 하여라. \q 길갈에 가지 말고, 벧아웬으로 올라가지 마라. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세한다" 하고 맹세하지 마라.
ko.R: 이스라엘아, 너는 신실하지 않아도 \q 유다는 죄를 짓지 말아야 한다. \q 길갈에 예배하러 가지 말고, 벧아웬으로 올라가지 마라. \q 그곳에서 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세한다" 하고 약속하지 마라.

vi.L: Dù ngươi làm điếm, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q chớ để Giu-đa mắc tội; \q chớ đi đến Ghinh-ganh, chớ đi lên Bết-A-ven, \q và chớ thề: "[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống."
vi.B: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù ngươi làm điếm, \q đừng để Giu-đa mắc tội. \q Đừng đến Ghinh-ganh, đừng đi lên Bết-A-ven, \q và đừng thề rằng: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống."
vi.R: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù ngươi bất trung, \q Giu-đa cũng không được mắc tội như vậy. \q Đừng đến thờ phượng tại Ghinh-ganh hay đi lên Bết-A-ven. \q Đừng hứa nguyện tại đó mà nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống."

sw.L: Ingawa wewe, Israeli, unafanya ukahaba, \q Yuda asiwe na hatia; \q wala msiende Gilgali, wala msipande Beth-aveni, \q wala msiape, "[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo."
sw.B: Ingawa wewe, Israeli, unafanya ukahaba, \q usimwache Yuda awe na hatia. \q Msiende Gilgali; msipande Beth-aveni; \q wala msiape, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo."
sw.R: Israeli, hata kama wewe si mwaminifu, \q Yuda asiwe na hatia pia. \q Msiende kuabudu huko Gilgali wala msipande Beth-aveni. \q Msiahidi kitu huko kwa kusema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo."

pt.L: Se tu te prostituis, Israel, \q que Judá não se torne culpado; \q e não vão a Gilgal, e não subam a Bete-Áven, \q e não jurem: "[Tão certo como] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vive."
pt.B: Ainda que tu, Israel, te prostituas, \q que Judá não se torne culpado. \q Fiquem longe de Gilgal; não subam a Bete-Áven; \q e não façam o juramento: "Tão certo como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vive."
pt.R: Israel, mesmo que tu sejas infiel, \q Judá não deve se tornar culpado também. \q Não vão adorar em Gilgal nem subam a Bete-Áven. \q Não façam promessas ali, dizendo: "Tão certo como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vive."

am.L: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አንተ ዝሙት ብትፈጽም፣ \q ይሁዳ በደለኛ አይሁን፤ \q ወደ ጌልገላ አትሂዱ፤ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ፤ \q «ሕያው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}}» ብላችሁም አትማሉ።
am.B: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አንተ ዝሙት ብትፈጽምም \q ይሁዳ በደለኛ እንዳይሆን። \q ወደ ጌልገላ አትሂዱ፤ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ፤ \q «ሕያው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}}» ብላችሁም አትማሉ።
am.R: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ አንተ ታማኝ ባትሆንም \q ይሁዳ ደግሞ በደለኛ መሆን የለበትም። \q በጌልገላ ለማምለክ አትሂዱ፤ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ። \q በዚያም «ሕያው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}}» እያላችሁ አትማሉ።

hi.L: हे इस्राएल, यद्यपि तुम वेश्यावृत्ति करते हो, \q तो भी यहूदा दोषी न बने; \q और गिलगाल को न जाओ, और बेत-आवेन को न चढ़ो, \q और यह शपथ न खाओ, "जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ।"
hi.B: हे इस्राएल, यद्यपि तुम वेश्यावृत्ति करते हो, \q तो भी यहूदा को दोषी न बनने दो। \q गिलगाल से दूर रहो, बेत-आवेन को न चढ़ो, \q और यह शपथ न खाओ, "जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ।"
hi.R: हे इस्राएल, चाहे तुम बेवफ़ा हो, \q फिर भी यहूदा दोषी न बने। \q गिलगाल में पूजा करने न जाओ, न बेत-आवेन को चढ़ो। \q वहाँ यह कहकर वचन न दो, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के जीवन की शपथ।"

ru.L: Если ты блудишь, Израиль, \q пусть не провинится Иуда; \q и не ходите в Галгал, и не поднимайтесь в Беф-Авен, \q и не клянитесь: «[Как] жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»
ru.B: Если ты, Израиль, блудишь, \q пусть Иуда не станет виновным. \q Не ходите в Галгал, не поднимайтесь в Беф-Авен \q и не клянитесь: «Как верно то, что жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»
ru.R: Израиль, даже если ты изменяешь, \q Иуда не должен тоже стать виновным. \q Не ходите поклоняться в Галгал и не поднимайтесь в Беф-Авен. \q Не давайте там обещаний, говоря: «Как верно то, что жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»

ja.L: イスラエルよ、あなたが淫行をしても、 \q ユダは罪ある者となるな。 \q ギルガルに行くな。ベト・アベンに上るな。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる」と誓うな。
ja.B: イスラエルよ、たとえあなたが淫行にふけっても、 \q ユダまで罪ある者となってはならない。 \q ギルガルに行ってはならない。ベト・アベンに上ってはならない。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる」と誓ってはならない。
ja.R: イスラエルよ、たとえあなたが神を裏切っても、 \q ユダまで罪を犯してはいけない。 \q ギルガルへ礼拝に行ってはいけない。ベト・アベンに上ってはいけない。 \q そこで「生きておられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にかけて」と言って誓ってはいけない。

decisions.choice: Beth-aven ("house of wickedness"): Hosea's mocking name for Bethel ("house of God")
alternatives: Beth-aven: the village of that name near Bethel
decisions.reason: Bethel was the chief royal shrine of the northern kingdom, where Jeroboam set up a golden calf (1 Kings 12:28-33; Amos 7:13). Its name means "house of God". Hosea calls it Beth-aven, "house of wickedness" or "house of nothing", because what is worshiped there is worthless. Amos had made the same pun: "Bethel will come to nothing" (Amos 5:5). There was also a village called Beth-aven near Bethel (Joshua 7:2; 18:12), which may have given Hosea the name. The name returns in 5:8 and 10:5, and 10:5 confirms that the calf of Bethel is meant.

decisions.choice: Gilgal: an old holy place near the Jordan, now a shrine of false worship
decisions.reason: Gilgal was where Israel camped after crossing the Jordan (Joshua 4:19-20) and where Saul was made king (1 Samuel 11:14-15). In Hosea's day it was a center of worship that the prophets condemned (9:15; 12:12; Amos 4:4; 5:5).

decisions.choice: do not swear "As the LORD lives": do not take the LORD's name in oaths at these shrines
decisions.reason: Swearing by the LORD was right in itself (Deuteronomy 6:13; Jeremiah 4:2). But at shrines given to false worship, using his name only mixed his worship with that of other gods (Amos 8:14; Zephaniah 1:5).

decisions.choice: though Israel is unfaithful, let not Judah become guilty: a warning to the southern kingdom
alternatives: the commands are to Israel itself
decisions.reason: Israel here is the northern kingdom. Judah, the southern kingdom, is warned not to share its guilt; Bethel and Gilgal were close to Judah's border, and people from the south went there to worship (Amos 5:5 names Beersheba too). The commands that follow are plural: Judah, and anyone else listening, must stay away.

decisions.choice: to worship ... there
decisions.reason: Readable says why the people went to Gilgal and where the oath was taken, which the Hebrew leaves implied (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: prostitute yourself (Literal, Balanced); are unfaithful (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for zanah (4:10).

decisions.choice: "Bet-avén"; "Guilgal"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish forms (1 Samuel 13:5; Joshua); the play on Bethel is in the meaning decision's footnote.

decisions.choice: "[[vayan|vayáis]]", "[[suban|subáis]]", "[[juren|juréis]]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew commands are plural, though Israel was addressed as tú in the first line, so they take the plural_you span; the switch follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "벧아웬" at every level
decisions.reason: Hosea's mocking name for Bethel ("house of wickedness" for "house of God"), spelled as in Joshua 7:2; the shared footnote explains the play.

decisions.choice: "Ghinh-ganh"; "Bết-A-ven"
decisions.reason: Ghinh-ganh as published; Bết-A-ven is the terms note's form for Hosea's mocking name for Bê-tên, kept at every level as the English keeps Beth-aven, with the footnote giving the wordplay. The oath is the published "Thật như CHÚA hằng sống" (1 Kings 1:29).

decisions.choice: "Kama BWANA aishivyo"
decisions.reason: The oath as the Samuel notes word it at every level (1 Samuel 14:39); "Beth-aveni" is the form Joshua and Samuel use.

decisions.choice: Gilgal; Bete-Áven (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 5:8; 10:5, 8): Hosea's mocking name for Bethel (m1) is "Bete-Áven" at every level, as the English keeps "Beth-aven", written like "Betel" with the Portuguese "Bete-" and the accent that shows the stress; Gilgal keeps its usual form. The note gives the play between "casa de Deus" and "casa da maldade".

decisions.choice: tu (Israel); vocês (the commands)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to Israel in the singular and then gives the three commands in the plural, so Portuguese turns from "tu" to "vocês" ("não vão", "não subam", "não jurem"), which English "you" cannot show.

decisions.choice: "ቤትአዌን", "ጌልገላ"; the oath "«ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን»"
decisions.reason: The place names as 1 Samuel 13:5 and Joshua 15:7 on main; the oath is the usual Amharic oath form ("by the living LORD"). Israel is "አንተ" here, as the Hebrew's masculine singular; the commands that follow are plural ("አትሂዱ").

decisions.choice: गिलगाल; बेत-आवेन; जीवित प्रभु की शपथ (L, B), प्रभु के जीवन की शपथ (R)
decisions.reason: Gilgal and Beth-aven keep the forms of Joshua and 1 Samuel (गिलगाल, बेत-आवेन). Beth-aven, "house of wickedness", is Hosea's mocking name for Bethel, "house of God" (m1). The oath keeps the wording of Jeremiah 4:2 at each level.

decisions.choice: Галгал; Беф-Авен
decisions.reason: Gilgal and Beth-aven keep the forms of 1 Samuel 10:8 and 14:23 in this translation. Beth-aven, "house of wickedness", is Hosea's mocking name for Bethel, "house of God" (m1); every level keeps the name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: [Как] жив ГОСПОДЬ (L); Как верно то, что жив ГОСПОДЬ (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula in the wording of Jeremiah 38:16 in this translation.

decisions.choice: Gilgal "ギルガル" and Beth-aven "ベト・アベン" at every level, the forms of Joshua and 1 Samuel; the mocking sense "house of wickedness" for Bethel (m1) is left to the footnote, as the English leaves it. The oath chai YHWH "主は生きておられる" (L, B), "生きておられる主にかけて" (R), as 1 Samuel.
decisions.reason: One form per place; the oath formula as in the historical books.

records.literal_gloss: For like a heifer stubborn is stubborn Israel; now will pasture them Yahweh like a lamb in the broad place?

en.L: For like a stubborn heifer \q Israel is stubborn; \q now will {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pasture them \q like a lamb in a broad place?
en.B: Israel is stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. \q Can {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} now pasture them like a lamb in an open meadow?
en.R: Israel is as stubborn as a young cow that refuses to be led. \q So how can {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} now take care of them \q as a shepherd cares for a lamb in a wide pasture?

es.L: Porque como una novilla terca \q es terco Israel; \q ¿ahora los apacentará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q como a un cordero en campo abierto?
es.B: Israel es terco, como una novilla terca. \q ¿Podrá ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} apacentarlos como a un cordero en un prado abierto?
es.R: Israel es tan terco como una vaca joven que no se deja guiar. \q ¿Cómo podrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuidarlos ahora \q como un pastor cuida a un cordero en un pastizal amplio?

fr.L: Car comme une génisse rétive, \q Israël est rétif ; \q maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les fera-t-il paître \q comme un agneau dans un lieu spacieux ?
fr.B: Israël est rétif comme une génisse rétive. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} peut-il maintenant les faire paître comme un agneau dans une vaste prairie ?
fr.R: Israël est aussi têtu qu’une jeune vache qui refuse d’être conduite. \q Alors comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pourrait-il maintenant prendre soin d’eux \q comme un berger prend soin d’un agneau dans un grand pâturage ?

ko.L: 이스라엘은 고집 센 암송아지처럼 \q 고집을 부렸다. \q 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 \q 넓은 곳의 어린양처럼 먹이시겠느냐?
ko.B: 이스라엘은 고집 센 암송아지처럼 고집을 부린다. \q 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 넓은 풀밭의 어린양처럼 먹이시겠느냐?
ko.R: 이스라엘은 끌려가지 않으려고 버티는 어린 암소처럼 고집이 세다. \q 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어떻게 그들을 돌보시겠느냐? \q 목자가 넓은 풀밭에서 어린양을 돌보듯 하시겠느냐?

vi.L: Vì như con bò cái tơ ương ngạnh, \q Y-sơ-ra-ên ương ngạnh; \q bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chăn chúng \q như chiên con trong đồng rộng sao?
vi.B: Y-sơ-ra-ên ương ngạnh như con bò cái tơ ương ngạnh. \q Lẽ nào bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại chăn chúng như chiên con trên đồng cỏ rộng?
vi.R: Y-sơ-ra-ên cứng đầu như con bò cái tơ không chịu để ai dắt. \q Vậy làm sao bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể chăm sóc chúng \q như người chăn chăm sóc chiên con trên đồng cỏ rộng?

sw.L: Kwa maana kama ndama jike mkaidi \q Israeli amekuwa mkaidi; \q je, sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawalisha \q kama mwana-kondoo mahali palipo wazi?
sw.B: Israeli ni mkaidi kama ndama jike mkaidi. \q Je, sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaweza kuwalisha kama mwana-kondoo katika malisho mapana?
sw.R: Israeli ni mkaidi kama ndama jike anayekataa kuongozwa. \q Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawezaje sasa kuwatunza \q kama mchungaji anavyomtunza mwana-kondoo katika malisho mapana?

pt.L: Pois como uma novilha teimosa \q Israel é teimoso; \q agora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} os apascentará \q como a um cordeiro num lugar espaçoso?
pt.B: Israel é teimoso como uma novilha teimosa. \q Poderá {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} agora apascentá-los como a um cordeiro em pasto aberto?
pt.R: Israel é tão teimoso como uma novilha que não se deixa conduzir. \q Então como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} pode cuidar deles agora \q como um pastor cuida de um cordeiro num pasto amplo?

am.L: እስራኤል እንደ እልከኛ ጊደር \q እልከኛ ሆኗልና፤ \q አሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ጠቦት \q በሰፊ ስፍራ ያሰማራቸዋልን?
am.B: እስራኤል እንደ እልከኛ ጊደር እልከኛ ነው። \q ታዲያ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ጠቦት በሰፊ መስክ ሊያሰማራቸው ይችላልን?
am.R: እስራኤል መመራትን እንደማትፈልግ ጊደር እልከኛ ነው። \q ታዲያ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አሁን እንዴት ሊንከባከባቸው ይችላል፤ \q እረኛ በሰፊ መስክ ጠቦትን እንደሚንከባከብ?

hi.L: क्योंकि हठीली बछिया के समान \q इस्राएल हठीला है; \q अब क्या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन्हें \q खुले स्थान में मेम्ने के समान चराएँगे?
hi.B: इस्राएल हठीली बछिया के समान हठीला है। \q क्या अब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन्हें खुले चरागाह में मेम्ने के समान चरा सकते हैं?
hi.R: इस्राएल उस बछिया के समान ज़िद्दी है जो हाँकी नहीं जाती। \q तो अब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनकी देखभाल कैसे करें, \q जैसे चरवाहा खुले चरागाह में मेम्ने की देखभाल करता है?

ru.L: Ведь как упрямая тёлка, \q упрям Израиль; \q теперь будет ли пасти их {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, \q как ягнёнка на просторе?
ru.B: Израиль упрям, как упрямая тёлка. \q Может ли теперь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пасти их, как ягнёнка на широком лугу?
ru.R: Израиль упрям, как молодая корова, которая не даёт себя вести. \q Как же теперь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет заботиться о них, \q как пастух заботится о ягнёнке на широком пастбище?

ja.L: イスラエルは、かたくなな雌の子牛のように \q かたくなだ。 \q 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを、 \q 広い所の子羊のように養ってくださるだろうか？
ja.B: イスラエルは、かたくなな雌の子牛のように、かたくなだ。 \q 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを、広々とした牧場の子羊のように養ってくださるだろうか？
ja.R: イスラエルは、引かれて行くのをいやがる若い雌牛のように、強情だ。 \q それなのに、どうして今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らの世話をしてくださるだろうか？ \q 羊飼いが広い牧場で子羊の世話をするように。

decisions.choice: a stubborn heifer: a young cow that will not take the yoke or be led
decisions.reason: A heifer was trained to pull a plow or thresh grain (10:11). A stubborn one balks and pulls away. Israel resists the LORD in the same way. The word "stubborn" is the one used for the rebellious son of Deuteronomy 21:18.

decisions.choice: now will the LORD pasture them like a lamb in a broad place? a question expecting the answer no
alternatives: now the LORD will pasture them like a lamb in open country (a threat)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no word marking a question, but the contrast with the stubborn heifer makes it likely: how can the LORD lead such a people to good pasture like a lamb? Others read it as a statement, either a threat (the LORD will now leave them like a lamb alone in open country, exposed to danger) or, less likely, a promise (Isaiah 30:23).

decisions.choice: a young cow that refuses to be led ... as a shepherd cares for a lamb
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the stubborn heifer (m1) and says that pasturing means a shepherd's care.

decisions.choice: The LORD in the third person in the prophet's question takes "〜てくださる" ("養ってくださるだろうか"), not "養われる", which would read as passive.
decisions.reason: The Psalms' rule for respect forms that could be misread.

records.literal_gloss: Joined [to] idols [is] Ephraim; leave him alone.

en.L: Ephraim [is] joined to idols; leave him alone.
en.B: Ephraim is joined to idols; let him alone.
en.R: Ephraim is tied to his idols. Leave him alone!

es.L: Unido [está] Efraín a los ídolos; déjalo.
es.B: Efraín está unido a los ídolos; déjalo.
es.R: Efraín está atado a sus ídolos. ¡Déjalo!

fr.B: Éphraïm est lié aux idoles : laisse-le.
fr.R: Éphraïm est attaché à ses idoles. Laisse-le !

ko.L: 에브라임이 우상들과 한패가 되었으니, 그를 내버려 두어라.
ko.B: 에브라임이 우상들과 한데 묶였으니, 그를 내버려 두어라.
ko.R: 에브라임은 자기 우상들에게 매여 있다. 그를 내버려 두어라!

vi.L: Ép-ra-im bị gắn liền với các thần tượng; hãy để mặc nó.
vi.B: Ép-ra-im đã kết hiệp với các thần tượng; hãy mặc kệ nó.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im đã gắn chặt với các thần tượng của nó. Hãy để mặc nó!

sw.R: Efraimu amefungamana na sanamu zake. Mwache!
