pt.R: Efraim está preso aos seus ídolos. Deixa-o em paz!

hi.L: एप्रैम मूर्तियों से जुड़ गया [है]; उसे छोड़ दो।
hi.B: एप्रैम मूर्तियों से जुड़ गया है; उसे रहने दो।
hi.R: एप्रैम अपनी मूर्तियों से बँध गया है। उसे छोड़ दो!

ru.L: Прилепился к идолам Ефрем; оставь его.
ru.B: Ефрем привязан к идолам; оставь его.
ru.R: Ефрем прирос к своим идолам. Оставь его!

ja.L: エフライムは偶像に結びついている。彼を放っておけ。
ja.B: エフライムは偶像と結びついている。彼を放っておきなさい。
ja.R: エフライム（北のイスラエル王国）は、自分の偶像にしっかりと結びついている。放っておきなさい！

decisions.choice: Ephraim: the northern kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the largest tribe in the north, in the central hill country, and the tribe of Jeroboam, the first king of the northern kingdom (1 Kings 11:26). Hosea uses its name for the whole northern kingdom, often side by side with "Israel" (5:3, 5; 11:8) and set against Judah in the south (5:12-14; 6:4). Here it is the first of thirty-seven times in the book. This is the main note on the name; later verses refer back to it.

decisions.choice: joined to idols: bound up with idols, as in a partnership
decisions.reason: The verb is used for being joined in alliance or partnership (Genesis 14:3; 2 Chronicles 20:35-37), and for charms that bind (Deuteronomy 18:11). Ephraim has tied itself to its idols. The word for idols comes from a root meaning "shape" or "fashion": things made by hand (8:4; 13:2; 14:9).

decisions.choice: leave him alone: give Ephraim up to his idols
alternatives: spoken to the prophet: do not try to rebuke him any longer
decisions.reason: The command is singular. It may be spoken to Judah, warned in verse 15 to stay away, or to the prophet, told not to plead further. Either way Ephraim is to be left to the idols he has chosen.

decisions.choice: tied to his idols
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plainer word for "joined" and adds "his", since the idols are Ephraim's own.

decisions.choice: Ephraim
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the name Ephraim, as the prophet uses it, and the culture decision says what it stands for (m1). Readable does not change it to "Israel" or "the northern kingdom", because Hosea sets the two names side by side (5:3).

decisions.choice: "Efraín"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish form; in Hosea it names the northern kingdom, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "Éphraïm" at every level, with masculine agreement ("laisse-le")
decisions.reason: As the English, which keeps the name and explains it in a culture decision; the form is that of every published French book.

decisions.choice: "에브라임" at every level, for the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Hosea's name for the northern kingdom; the English keeps it at every level with a culture decision, and Korean does the same.

decisions.choice: "Ép-ra-im", referred to as "nó"
decisions.reason: Ephraim stands for the northern kingdom and keeps its name at every level, as the English does; as a nation it is "nó", following the terms note.

decisions.choice: "Efraimu"
decisions.reason: Kept at every level, as the English does; the meaning decision explains that it names the northern kingdom. The name has its published Swahili form.

decisions.choice: Efraim (every level); deixa-o
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Efraim, Hosea's name for the northern kingdom (m1), is kept at every level, as the English keeps it (r-en-2), in the form the Old Testament terms give it. The command is singular (m3), so the "tu" imperative "deixa".

decisions.choice: "ኤፍሬም" for Ephraim as a name for the northern kingdom; "ጣዖታት" for idols (ʿatsabbim)
decisions.reason: Ephraim is named as the tribe is on main, and stands for Israel through Hosea; the LORD speaks of him as "he" and to him as "አንተ". "ተወው" is singular, as the Hebrew command.

decisions.choice: एप्रैम
decisions.reason: Ephraim keeps its name at every level (एप्रैम, as Genesis and Isaiah); it stands for the northern kingdom (m1).

decisions.choice: Ефрем
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the name Ephraim, the northern kingdom (m1), as the English does; the form is that of Genesis and the Pentateuch note.

decisions.choice: Ephraim "エフライム" at every level for the northern kingdom (m1), as Isaiah 7; Readable adds "（北のイスラエル王国）" at its first appearance in the book, as Isaiah's Readable explains it. Ephraim as a people is "彼" where the Hebrew has "him". 'atsabbim "偶像" (every level).
decisions.reason: Hosea names the northern kingdom Ephraim some thirty times; a reader needs to know who it is once.

records.literal_gloss: Has turned their drink; they continually prostitute [themselves]; they have loved, give! shame, her shields.

en.L: Their drink is gone; \q they keep prostituting themselves; \q her shields have loved, loved shame.
en.B: When their drinking is over, \q they prostitute themselves again and again; \q her rulers dearly love what is shameful.
en.R: When they have finished drinking, \q they go on being unfaithful again and again. \q Their leaders love what is shameful.

es.L: Se acabó su bebida; \q se prostituyen sin cesar; \q sus escudos han amado, amado la deshonra.
es.B: Cuando se les acaba la bebida, \q se prostituyen una y otra vez; \q sus gobernantes aman con pasión lo vergonzoso.
es.R: Cuando terminan de beber, \q siguen siendo infieles una y otra vez. \q Sus dirigentes aman lo vergonzoso.

fr.L: Leur boisson est passée ; \q ils ne cessent de se prostituer ; \q ses boucliers ont aimé, aimé la honte.
fr.B: Quand ils ont fini de boire, \q ils se prostituent encore et encore ; \q ses chefs aiment passionnément ce qui est honteux.
fr.R: Quand ils ont fini de boire, \q ils continuent d’être infidèles, encore et encore. \q Leurs dirigeants aiment ce qui est honteux.

ko.L: 그들의 술이 떨어지면 \q 그들은 계속 음행한다. \q 그 여자의 방패들이 수치를 사랑하고 또 사랑한다.

ko.R: 그들은 술을 다 마시고 나면 \q 또다시 신실하지 않은 짓을 한다. \q 그들의 지도자들은 부끄러운 일을 좋아한다.

vi.L: Rượu của chúng đã hết; \q chúng cứ làm điếm mãi; \q những cái khiên của nó đã yêu, đã yêu sự sỉ nhục.
vi.B: Khi cuộc nhậu của chúng đã tàn, \q chúng lại làm điếm hết lần này đến lần khác; \q những kẻ cai trị của nó say mê điều nhục nhã.
vi.R: Khi đã uống xong, \q chúng lại tiếp tục bất trung hết lần này đến lần khác. \q Các nhà lãnh đạo của chúng ưa thích điều đáng hổ thẹn.

sw.L: Kinywaji chao kimekwisha; \q wanaendelea kufanya ukahaba; \q ngao zake zimependa, zimependa aibu.
sw.B: Wanapomaliza kunywa, \q wanafanya ukahaba tena na tena; \q watawala wake wanapenda sana yaliyo ya aibu.
sw.R: Wanapomaliza kunywa pombe, \q wanaendelea kutokuwa waaminifu tena na tena. \q Viongozi wao wanapenda mambo ya aibu.

pt.L: A bebida deles acabou; \q eles se prostituem sem parar; \q os escudos dela amaram, amaram a vergonha.
pt.B: Quando acaba a bebedeira, \q eles se prostituem repetidas vezes; \q os governantes dela amam ardentemente o que é vergonhoso.
pt.R: Quando terminam de beber, \q continuam sendo infiéis sem parar. \q Os seus líderes amam o que é vergonhoso.

am.L: መጠጣቸው አልቋል፤ \q ዘወትር ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ \q ጋሻዎቿ ወደዱ፤ ኀፍረትን ወደዱ።
am.B: መጠጣቸውን ሲጨርሱ \q ደጋግመው ዝሙት ይፈጽማሉ፤ \q ገዢዎቿም አሳፋሪውን ነገር እጅግ ይወዳሉ።
am.R: ጠጥተው ሲጨርሱ \q ደጋግመው ታማኝነታቸውን ያጓድላሉ። \q መሪዎቻቸውም አሳፋሪውን ነገር ይወዳሉ።

hi.L: उनका पेय समाप्त हो गया है; \q वे वेश्यावृत्ति करते ही रहते हैं; \q उसकी ढालों ने लज्जा से प्रेम किया, बहुत प्रेम किया।
hi.B: जब उनका पीना समाप्त होता है, \q तो वे बार-बार वेश्यावृत्ति करते हैं; \q उसके शासक लज्जा की बातों से बहुत प्रेम करते हैं।
hi.R: जब वे पी चुकते हैं, \q तो बार-बार बेवफ़ाई करते रहते हैं। \q उनके अगुवे लज्जा के कामों से प्रेम करते हैं।

ru.L: Кончилось их питьё; \q блудят и блудят; \q её щиты возлюбили, возлюбили позор.
ru.B: Когда кончается их попойка, \q они блудят снова и снова; \q её правители горячо любят позорное.
ru.R: Когда они перестают пить, \q они снова и снова изменяют. \q Их вожди любят то, что постыдно.

ja.L: 彼らの酒は尽き、 \q 彼らは淫行に淫行を重ねる。 \q その盾たちは恥を愛した。こよなく愛した。
ja.B: 酒宴が終わると、 \q 彼らは淫行を繰り返す。 \q その支配者たちは、恥ずべきことをこよなく愛している。
ja.R: 酒を飲み終わると、 \q 彼らはまた何度も不誠実なことをする。 \q 彼らの指導者たちは、恥ずべきことが大好きだ。

decisions.choice: the Hebrew of this verse is very uncertain
alternatives: her rulers love [the word] "Give!", the shame
decisions.reason: Almost every phrase of this verse is hard. "Their drink is gone" (or "has turned") may mean that their drinking bout is over and they go on to the sexual rites, or that their wine has turned sour. "They have loved, give!" may be one doubled word meaning "they dearly love", or it may mean "they love [the cry] 'Give!'", that is, they love bribes or payment. The ancient Greek translation reads the verse quite differently. The translation follows the most likely sense of the Hebrew text as it stands.

decisions.choice: her shields: her rulers
decisions.reason: Rulers are called "shields" because they were to protect their people (Psalm 47:10; 89:19). "Her" refers to the nation, pictured as a woman, as in 2:4.

decisions.choice: they keep prostituting themselves: the form doubles the verb for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb ("prostituting, they prostitute"), stressing that they do it without stopping. See the note at verse 10.

decisions.choice: her rulers (Balanced); their leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "shields" means (m2). Readable uses "their" for the people, as in the first half of the verse.

source.text: צָרַ֥ר ר֛וּחַ אוֹתָ֖הּ בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וְיֵבֹ֖שׁוּ מִזִּבְחוֹתָֽם

records.literal_gloss: Has wrapped a wind her in its wings, and they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.

en.L: A wind has wrapped her up in its wings, \q and they will be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
en.B: A wind has bundled her up in its wings, \q and they will be put to shame because of their sacrifices.
en.R: A wind has caught them up in its wings to carry them away, \q and they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.

es.L: Un viento la ha envuelto en sus alas, \q y se avergonzarán a causa de sus sacrificios.
es.B: Un viento la ha envuelto en sus alas, \q y quedarán avergonzados por sus sacrificios.
es.R: Un viento los ha atrapado en sus alas para llevárselos, \q y se avergonzarán de sus sacrificios.

fr.L: Un vent l’a enveloppée dans ses ailes, \q et ils auront honte à cause de leurs sacrifices.
fr.B: Un vent l’a enroulée dans ses ailes, \q et ils seront couverts de honte à cause de leurs sacrifices.
fr.R: Un vent les a saisis dans ses ailes pour les emporter, \q et ils auront honte de leurs sacrifices.

ko.L: 바람이 그 여자를 날개로 감쌌으니, \q 그들이 자기들의 제사 때문에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.
ko.B: 바람이 그 여자를 날개로 휩싸 갔으니, \q 그들은 자기들의 제사 때문에 수치를 당할 것이다.
ko.R: 바람이 날개로 그들을 휩쓸어 날려 갈 것이다. \q 그들은 자기들이 드린 제사 때문에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.

vi.L: Gió đã cuốn nó trong cánh mình, \q và chúng sẽ bị hổ thẹn vì các sinh tế của chúng.
vi.B: Một ngọn gió đã cuộn nó lại trong đôi cánh mình, \q và chúng sẽ phải xấu hổ vì các sinh tế của chúng.
vi.R: Một cơn gió đã cuốn chúng vào cánh nó để mang chúng đi, \q và chúng sẽ xấu hổ về các sinh tế của mình.

sw.L: Upepo umemfunga katika mabawa yake, \q nao wataaibika kwa sababu ya dhabihu zao.
sw.B: Upepo umemfunga ndani ya mabawa yake, \q nao wataaibishwa kwa sababu ya dhabihu zao.
sw.R: Upepo umewanyakua katika mabawa yake ili kuwapeleka mbali, \q nao wataona aibu kwa sababu ya dhabihu zao.

pt.L: Um vento a envolveu nas suas asas, \q e eles se envergonharão por causa dos seus sacrifícios.
pt.B: Um vento a enrolou nas suas asas, \q e eles serão envergonhados por causa dos seus sacrifícios.
pt.R: Um vento os apanhou nas suas asas para levá-los embora, \q e eles vão ter vergonha dos seus sacrifícios.

am.L: ነፋስ በክንፎቹ ጠቀለላት፤ \q ከመሥዋዕቶቻቸውም የተነሣ ያፍራሉ።
am.B: ነፋስ በክንፎቹ ጠቅልሏታል፤ \q በመሥዋዕቶቻቸውም ምክንያት ያፍራሉ።
am.R: ነፋስ ጠራርጎ ሊወስዳቸው በክንፎቹ ይዟቸዋል፤ \q በመሥዋዕቶቻቸውም ያፍራሉ።

hi.L: एक आँधी ने उसे अपने पंखों में लपेट लिया है, \q और वे अपने बलिदानों के कारण लज्जित होंगे।
hi.B: एक आँधी ने उसे अपने पंखों में बाँध लिया है, \q और वे अपने बलिदानों के कारण लज्जित किए जाएँगे।
hi.R: एक आँधी ने उन्हें उड़ा ले जाने के लिए अपने पंखों में उठा लिया है, \q और वे अपने बलिदानों के कारण लज्जित होंगे।

ru.L: Ветер завернул её в свои крылья, \q и устыдятся они своих жертв.
ru.B: Ветер подхватил её на свои крылья, \q и они будут посрамлены из-за своих жертв.
ru.R: Ветер подхватил их на крылья, чтобы унести прочь, \q и они устыдятся своих жертв.

ja.L: 風がその翼に彼女を包み込んだ。 \q 彼らは自分たちのいけにえのゆえに恥を見る。
ja.B: 風がその翼で彼女を包み込んだ。 \q 彼らは自分たちのいけにえのゆえに恥を受ける。
ja.R: 風がその翼で彼らを捕らえ、連れ去っていく。 \q 彼らは自分たちのささげたいけにえを恥じるようになる。

decisions.choice: a wind has wrapped her in its wings: a storm that will sweep the nation away
alternatives: a spirit (of prostitution) has wrapped her in its wings
decisions.reason: The "wind" is pictured as a bird with wings that gathers up the nation ("her") and carries it off, as the wind blows chaff away (13:15; Isaiah 41:16). The same Hebrew word means "spirit", and some hear an echo of the "spirit of prostitution" of verse 12: the urge that has gripped them will also carry them off. The verb ("has wrapped") speaks of the judgment as already done, because it is certain.

decisions.choice: because of their sacrifices (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation is usually taken to read "because of their altars", from a Hebrew word that differs by a few letters. The sense is much the same: the worship they trusted will bring them shame.

decisions.choice: caught them up ... to carry them away
decisions.reason: Readable says "them" for the nation the Hebrew calls "her", and adds where the wind's wings take them (m1).
